bad_en: If the sale happens on a Monday in a week without a federal holiday, you have until midnight on Tuesday to cancel.
translation: Nếu đợt giảm giá diễn ra vào Thứ Hai trong tuần mà không có ngày nghỉ lễ liên bang, bạn có thời gian đến nửa đêm Thứ Ba để hủy.
back: If the sale takes place on a Monday of a week that is not a federal holiday, you have until midnight Tuesday to cancel.

en: If you are outside the United States and your Green Card will expire within six months, you should file Form I-90 as soon as you return to the United States.
bad_en: If you are outside the United States and your Green Card will expire within six months, you should file Form I-90 before you return to the United States.
translation: Nếu bạn ở bên ngoài Hoa Kỳ và Thẻ Xanh của bạn sẽ hết hạn trong vòng sáu tháng, bạn nên nộp Mẫu I-90 ngay khi bạn quay trở lại Hoa Kỳ.
back: If you are outside the United States and your Green Card will expire within six months, you should file Form I-90 as soon as you return to the United States.

en: If you are outside the United States and your Green Card will expire within six months, you should file Form I-90 as soon as you return to the United States.
bad_en: If you are outside the United States and your Green Card will expire within six months, you should file Form I-90 before you return to the United States.
translation: Nếu bạn ở ngoài Hoa Kỳ và Thẻ Xanh của bạn sẽ hết hạn trong vòng sáu tháng, bạn nên nộp Mẫu I-90 trước khi quay lại Hoa Kỳ.
back: If you are outside the United States and your Green Card will expire within six months, you should file Form I-90 before returning to the United States.

en: You may qualify for a long-term payment plan if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest.
bad_en: You may qualify for a long-term payment plan if you owe $50,000 or more in combined tax, penalties and interest.
translation: Bạn có thể đủ điều kiện tham gia kế hoạch thanh toán dài hạn nếu bạn nợ tổng cộng 50.000 USD tiền thuế, tiền phạt và tiền lãi.
back: You may qualify for a long-term payment plan if you owe a total of $50,000 in taxes, penalties and interest.

en: You may qualify for a long-term payment plan if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest.
bad_en: You may qualify for a long-term payment plan if you owe $50,000 or more in combined tax, penalties and interest.
translation: Bạn có thể đủ điều kiện tham gia kế hoạch thanh toán dài hạn nếu bạn nợ từ 50.000 USD trở lên tiền thuế, tiền phạt và tiền lãi.
back: You may qualify for a long-term payment plan if you owe $50,000 or more in taxes, penalties and interest.

en: You may qualify for a short-term payment plan if you owe less than $100,000 in combined tax, penalties and interest.
bad_en: You may qualify for a short-term payment plan if you owe more than $100,000 in combined tax, penalties and interest.
translation: Bạn có thể đủ điều kiện tham gia kế hoạch thanh toán ngắn hạn nếu bạn nợ tổng tiền thuế, tiền phạt và tiền lãi ít hơn 100.000 USD.
back: You may qualify for a short-term payment plan if you owe less than $100,000 in total taxes, penalties and interest.

en: You may qualify for a short-term payment plan if you owe less than $100,000 in combined tax, penalties and interest.
bad_en: You may qualify for a short-term payment plan if you owe more than $100,000 in combined tax, penalties and interest.
translation: Bạn có thể đủ điều kiện tham gia kế hoạch thanh toán ngắn hạn nếu bạn nợ tổng cộng hơn 100.000 đô la tiền thuế, tiền phạt và tiền lãi.
back: You may qualify for a short-term payment plan if you owe a total of more than $100,000 in taxes, penalties and interest.

en: You must replace your Green Card if you received it before you were 14 and you have reached your 14th birthday.
bad_en: You must replace your Green Card if you received it after you were 14 and you have reached your 14th birthday.
translation: Bạn phải thay thế Thẻ Xanh nếu bạn nhận được nó trước 14 tuổi và bạn đã đủ 14 tuổi.
back: You must replace your Green Card if you received it before age 14 and you are 14 years old.

en: You must replace your Green Card if you received it before you were 14 and you have reached your 14th birthday.
bad_en: You must replace your Green Card if you received it after you were 14 and you have reached your 14th birthday.
translation: Bạn phải thay thế Thẻ Xanh nếu bạn nhận được nó sau khi bạn 14 tuổi và bạn đã đủ 14 tuổi.
back: You must replace your Green Card if you received it after you turned 14 and you were 14 years old.

en: Report any changes as soon as possible and no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes no earlier than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: Báo cáo mọi thay đổi càng sớm càng tốt và không muộn hơn 10 ngày sau ngày cuối cùng của tháng xảy ra thay đổi.
back: Report any changes as soon as possible and no later than 10 days after the last day of the month in which the change occurred.

en: Report any changes as soon as possible and no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes no earlier than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: Báo cáo mọi thay đổi không sớm hơn 10 ngày sau ngày cuối cùng của tháng xảy ra thay đổi.
back: Report any changes no sooner than 10 days after the last day of the month in which the change occurred.

en: If your filing deadline is fast approaching, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.
bad_en: If your filing deadline has already passed, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.
translation: Nếu thời hạn nộp đơn của bạn sắp đến gần, hãy gọi số 1-800-669-4000 để yêu cầu một cuộc phỏng vấn ngay lập tức.
back: If your application deadline is approaching, call 1-800-669-4000 to request an immediate interview.

en: If your filing deadline is fast approaching, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.
bad_en: If your filing deadline has already passed, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.
translation: Nếu thời hạn nộp đơn của bạn đã qua, hãy gọi số 1-800-669-4000 để yêu cầu phỏng vấn ngay lập tức.
back: If your application deadline has passed, call 1-800-669-4000 to request an immediate interview.

en: You must file a charge with the EEOC before you can file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination.
bad_en: You must file a charge with the EEOC after you file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination.
translation: Bạn phải nộp đơn tố cáo lên EEOC trước khi có thể nộp đơn kiện về hành vi phân biệt đối xử trái pháp luật.
back: You must file a charge with the EEOC before you can file an unlawful discrimination lawsuit.

en: You must file a charge with the EEOC before you can file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination.
bad_en: You must file a charge with the EEOC after you file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination.
translation: Bạn phải nộp đơn tố cáo lên EEOC sau khi nộp đơn kiện về hành vi phân biệt đối xử trái pháp luật.
back: You must file a charge with the EEOC after filing an unlawful discrimination lawsuit.

en: Applicants should submit the form within 30 days from the date of their installment agreement acceptance letter.
bad_en: Applicants should submit the form at least 30 days after the date of their installment agreement acceptance letter.
translation: Người nộp đơn phải nộp đơn trong vòng 30 ngày kể từ ngày nhận được thư chấp nhận thỏa thuận trả góp.
back: The applicant must apply within 30 days of receiving the letter accepting the installment agreement.

en: Applicants should submit the form within 30 days from the date of their installment agreement acceptance letter.
bad_en: Applicants should submit the form at least 30 days after the date of their installment agreement acceptance letter.
translation: Người nộp đơn phải nộp đơn ít nhất 30 ngày sau ngày nhận được thư chấp nhận thỏa thuận trả góp.
back: The applicant must submit the application at least 30 days after the date of receipt of the installment agreement acceptance letter.

en: If you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged a user fee.
bad_en: Unless you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged a user fee.
translation: Nếu bạn đủ điều kiện tham gia gói thanh toán ngắn hạn, bạn sẽ không bị tính phí người dùng.
back: If you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged user fees.

en: If you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged a user fee.
bad_en: Unless you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged a user fee.
translation: Trừ khi bạn đủ điều kiện tham gia gói thanh toán ngắn hạn, bạn sẽ không bị tính phí người dùng.
back: Unless you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged user fees.

en: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived if you agree to make electronic debit payments.
bad_en: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived unless you agree to make electronic debit payments.
translation: Nếu bạn là người nộp thuế có thu nhập thấp, phí sử dụng sẽ được miễn nếu bạn đồng ý thực hiện thanh toán ghi nợ điện tử.
back: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee will be waived if you agree to make electronic debit payments.

en: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived if you agree to make electronic debit payments.
bad_en: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived unless you agree to make electronic debit payments.
translation: Nếu bạn là người nộp thuế có thu nhập thấp, phí sử dụng sẽ được miễn trừ khi bạn đồng ý thực hiện thanh toán ghi nợ điện tử.
back: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived when you agree to make electronic debit payments.

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
bad_en: Unless the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
translation: Nếu người bán đưa cho bạn bất kỳ mặt hàng nào, bạn phải cung cấp chúng cho người bán trong tình trạng tốt như khi bạn nhận được chúng.
back: If the seller gives you any items, you must deliver them to the seller in the same good condition as when you received them.

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
bad_en: Unless the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
translation: Trừ khi người bán đưa cho bạn bất kỳ mặt hàng nào, bạn phải cung cấp chúng cho người bán trong tình trạng tốt như khi bạn nhận được chúng.
back: Unless the seller gives you any items, you must deliver them to the seller in as good a condition as when you received them.

en: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is only extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination and a state agency enforcing that law.
bad_en: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is only extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination or a state agency enforcing that law.
translation: Đối với vấn đề phân biệt tuổi tác, thời hạn nộp đơn chỉ được kéo dài đến 300 ngày nếu có luật tiểu bang cấm phân biệt tuổi tác và cơ quan tiểu bang thực thi luật đó.
back: For age discrimination, the filing period may only be extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination and a state agency enforces that law.

en: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is only extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination and a state agency enforcing that law.
bad_en: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is only extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination or a state agency enforcing that law.
translation: Đối với vấn đề phân biệt tuổi tác, thời hạn nộp đơn chỉ được kéo dài đến 300 ngày nếu có luật tiểu bang cấm phân biệt tuổi tác hoặc cơ quan tiểu bang thực thi luật đó.
back: For age discrimination, the filing period may only be extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination or a state agency enforces such law.

en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, and filed all required returns.
bad_en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, or filed all required returns.
translation: Bạn có thể đủ điều kiện đăng ký trực tuyến nếu bạn nợ tổng cộng 50.000 USD tiền thuế, tiền phạt và tiền lãi, đồng thời đã nộp tất cả các tờ khai bắt buộc.
back: You may be eligible to apply online if you owe a total of $50,000 in taxes, penalties and interest, and have filed all required returns.

en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, and filed all required returns.
bad_en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, or filed all required returns.
translation: Bạn có thể đủ điều kiện đăng ký trực tuyến nếu bạn nợ tổng cộng 50.000 USD tiền thuế, tiền phạt và tiền lãi hoặc đã nộp tất cả các tờ khai bắt buộc.
back: You may be eligible to apply online if you owe a total of $50,000 in taxes, penalties and interest or have filed all required returns.

en: If you knowingly fail to report important changes, we may impose a sanction against your payments.
bad_en: Unless you knowingly fail to report important changes, we may impose a sanction against your payments.
translation: Nếu bạn cố tình không báo cáo những thay đổi quan trọng, chúng tôi có thể áp dụng hình thức xử phạt đối với các khoản thanh toán của bạn.
back: If you intentionally fail to report material changes, we may impose penalties on your payments.

en: If you knowingly fail to report important changes, we may impose a sanction against your payments.
bad_en: Unless you knowingly fail to report important changes, we may impose a sanction against your payments.
translation: Trừ khi bạn cố tình không báo cáo những thay đổi quan trọng, chúng tôi có thể áp dụng hình thức xử phạt đối với các khoản thanh toán của bạn.
back: Unless you intentionally fail to report material changes, we may impose penalties on your payments.

en: If you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
bad_en: Unless you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
translation: Nếu bạn gửi cho người đòi nợ một yêu cầu xác minh bằng văn bản trong khoảng thời gian 30 ngày này, người đòi nợ phải tạm dừng thu số tiền bạn đang tranh chấp.
back: If you send the debt collector a written request for verification within this 30-day period, the debt collector must temporarily stop collecting the amount you are disputing.

en: If you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
bad_en: Unless you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
translation: Trừ khi bạn gửi cho người đòi nợ một yêu cầu xác minh bằng văn bản trong khoảng thời gian 30 ngày này, người đòi nợ phải tạm dừng thu số tiền bạn đang tranh chấp.
back: Unless you send the debt collector a written request for verification within this 30-day period, the debt collector must temporarily stop collecting the amount you dispute.

en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, unless your card expires before your 16th birthday.
bad_en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, if your card expires before your 16th birthday.
translation: Nếu bạn nhận được thẻ trước 14 tuổi, bạn phải thay thẻ khi đủ 14 tuổi, trừ khi thẻ của bạn hết hạn trước sinh nhật thứ 16 của bạn.
back: If you received your card before you were 14 years old, you must replace it when you turn 14, unless your card expires before your 16th birthday.

en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, unless your card expires before your 16th birthday.
bad_en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, if your card expires before your 16th birthday.
translation: Nếu bạn nhận được thẻ trước 14 tuổi, bạn phải thay thẻ khi đủ 14 tuổi, nếu thẻ của bạn hết hạn trước sinh nhật thứ 16 của bạn.
back: If you received your card before you were 14 years old, you must replace it when you turn 14, if your card expires before your 16th birthday.

en: If we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.
bad_en: Unless we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.
translation: Nếu chúng tôi chấp thuận đơn đăng ký của bạn, chúng tôi sẽ gửi cho bạn một Thẻ xanh mới qua đường bưu điện.
back: If we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.

en: If we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.
bad_en: Unless we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.
translation: Trừ khi chúng tôi chấp thuận đơn đăng ký của bạn, chúng tôi sẽ gửi cho bạn một Thẻ xanh mới qua đường bưu điện.
back: Unless we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.

en: If you don't make the items available to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as you agreed under the contract.
bad_en: Even if you make the items available to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as you agreed under the contract.
translation: Nếu bạn không cung cấp các mặt hàng cho người bán, bạn vẫn phải chịu trách nhiệm thanh toán cho người bán như bạn đã thỏa thuận trong hợp đồng.
back: If you do not provide the items to the seller, you are still responsible for paying the seller as you agreed in the contract.

en: If you don't make the items available to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as you agreed under the contract.
bad_en: Even if you make the items available to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as you agreed under the contract.
translation: Ngay cả khi bạn cung cấp các mặt hàng cho người bán, bạn vẫn có trách nhiệm thanh toán cho người bán như bạn đã thỏa thuận trong hợp đồng.
back: Even if you supply the items to the seller, you are still responsible for paying the seller as you agreed in the contract.

en: The seller must give you two copies of a cancellation form.
bad_en: You must give the seller two copies of a cancellation form.
translation: Người bán phải đưa cho bạn hai bản sao đơn hủy.
back: The seller must give you two copies of the cancellation form.

en: The seller must give you two copies of a cancellation form.
bad_en: You must give the seller two copies of a cancellation form.
translation: Bạn phải đưa cho người bán hai bản sao mẫu đơn hủy.
back: You must give the seller two copies of the cancellation form.

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller.
bad_en: If you gave the seller any items, the seller must make them available to you.
translation: Nếu người bán đưa cho bạn bất kỳ mặt hàng nào, bạn phải cung cấp chúng cho người bán.
back: If the seller gives you any items, you must provide them to the seller.

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller.
bad_en: If you gave the seller any items, the seller must make them available to you.
translation: Nếu bạn đưa cho người bán bất kỳ mặt hàng nào, người bán phải cung cấp chúng cho bạn.
back: If you give the seller any items, the seller must provide them to you.

en: If we determine you must submit biometrics, we will mail you a biometrics appointment notice.
bad_en: If we determine you must submit biometrics, you must mail us a biometrics appointment request.
translation: Nếu chúng tôi xác định bạn phải gửi sinh trắc học, chúng tôi sẽ gửi cho bạn thông báo cuộc hẹn sinh trắc học qua thư.
back: If we determine you must submit biometrics, we will send you a biometric appointment notification by mail.

en: If we determine you must submit biometrics, we will mail you a biometrics appointment notice.
bad_en: If we determine you must submit biometrics, you must mail us a biometrics appointment request.
translation: Nếu chúng tôi xác định bạn phải gửi sinh trắc học, bạn phải gửi yêu cầu hẹn lấy sinh trắc học qua thư cho chúng tôi.
back: If we determine you must submit biometrics, you must mail us a biometrics appointment request.

en: You must report any of these changes to us, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.
bad_en: We must report any of these changes to you, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.
translation: Bạn phải báo cáo bất kỳ thay đổi nào trong số này cho chúng tôi vì chúng có thể ảnh hưởng đến khả năng hội đủ điều kiện nhận SSI của bạn.
back: You must report any of these changes to us because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.

en: You must report any of these changes to us, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.
bad_en: We must report any of these changes to you, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.
translation: Chúng tôi phải báo cáo bất kỳ thay đổi nào trong số này cho bạn vì chúng có thể ảnh hưởng đến khả năng hội đủ điều kiện nhận SSI của bạn.
back: We must report any of these changes to you because they could affect your eligibility for SSI.

en: We may overpay you, and you may have to pay us back.
bad_en: You may overpay us, and we may have to pay you back.
translation: Chúng tôi có thể trả quá nhiều cho bạn và bạn có thể phải trả lại cho chúng tôi.
back: We may overpay you and you may have to pay it back to us.

en: We may overpay you, and you may have to pay us back.
bad_en: You may overpay us, and we may have to pay you back.
translation: Bạn có thể trả quá nhiều cho chúng tôi và chúng tôi có thể phải trả lại cho bạn.
back: You may pay too much to us and we may have to pay you back.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once the debt collector receives your information, they have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: Sau khi nhận được thông tin xác nhận khoản nợ, bạn có 30 ngày để tranh chấp khoản nợ bằng văn bản.
back: Once you receive the debt confirmation, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once the debt collector receives your information, they have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: Sau khi người đòi nợ nhận được thông tin của bạn, họ có 30 ngày để tranh chấp khoản nợ bằng văn bản.
back: Once the debt collector receives your information, they have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: The debt collector must give you the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.
bad_en: You must give the debt collector the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.
translation: Người đòi nợ phải cho bạn biết tên của chủ nợ mà bạn mắc nợ.
back: The debt collector must tell you the name of the creditor to whom you owe money.

en: The debt collector must give you the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.
bad_en: You must give the debt collector the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.
translation: Bạn phải cung cấp cho người đòi nợ tên của chủ nợ mà bạn mắc nợ.
back: You must provide the debt collector with the name of the creditor to whom you owe the debt.

en: If the IRS approves your payment plan, a setup fee will be charged to you.
bad_en: If the IRS approves your payment plan, a setup fee will be paid to you.
translation: Nếu IRS chấp thuận kế hoạch thanh toán của bạn, bạn sẽ bị tính phí thiết lập.
back: If the IRS approves your payment plan, you will be charged a setup fee.

en: If the IRS approves your payment plan, a setup fee will be charged to you.
bad_en: If the IRS approves your payment plan, a setup fee will be paid to you.
translation: Nếu IRS chấp thuận gói thanh toán của bạn, phí thiết lập sẽ được trả cho bạn.
back: If the IRS approves your payment plan, the setup fee will be paid to you.

en: You may submit a motion to reopen to the same office that made the unfavorable decision.
bad_en: You may submit a motion to reopen to a different office than the one that made the unfavorable decision.
translation: Bạn có thể gửi kiến ​​nghị mở lại văn phòng tại cùng văn phòng đã đưa ra quyết định bất lợi.
back: You can file a petition to reopen the office at the same office that made the adverse decision.

en: You may submit a motion to reopen to the same office that made the unfavorable decision.
bad_en: You may submit a motion to reopen to a different office than the one that made the unfavorable decision.
translation: Bạn có thể gửi kiến ​​nghị mở lại văn phòng khác với văn phòng đã đưa ra quyết định bất lợi.
back: You can file a petition to reopen an office other than the office that made the adverse decision.

en: If you are a sole proprietor or independent contractor, apply for a payment plan as an individual.
bad_en: If you are a sole proprietor or independent contractor, apply for a payment plan as a business.
translation: Nếu bạn là chủ sở hữu duy nhất hoặc nhà thầu độc lập, hãy đăng ký kế hoạch thanh toán với tư cách cá nhân.
back: If you're a sole proprietor or independent contractor, sign up for a payment plan as an individual.

en: If you are a sole proprietor or independent contractor, apply for a payment plan as an individual.
bad_en: If you are a sole proprietor or independent contractor, apply for a payment plan as a business.
translation: Nếu bạn là chủ sở hữu duy nhất hoặc nhà thầu độc lập, hãy đăng ký kế hoạch thanh toán với tư cách là một doanh nghiệp.
back: If you're a sole proprietor or independent contractor, sign up for a payment plan as a business.

en: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults and children 12 years of age and older.
bad_en: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 6,000 mg for adults and children 12 years of age and older.
translation: 成人および12歳以上の小児の場合、24時間以内に摂取するアセトアミノフェンの最大総量は4,000mgを超えてはなりません。
back: For adults and children 12 years and older, the maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in a 24-hour period should not exceed 4,000 mg.

en: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults and children 12 years of age and older.
bad_en: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 6,000 mg for adults and children 12 years of age and older.
translation: 成人および12歳以上の小児の場合、24時間に摂取するアセトアミノフェンの最大総量は6,000mgを超えてはなりません。
back: For adults and children 12 years and older, the maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in a 24-hour period should not exceed 6,000 mg.

en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have three or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.
bad_en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have five or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.
translation: アセトアミノフェンを使用中に1日3杯以上のアルコール飲料を摂取すると、重度の肝障害が発生する可能性があります。
back: Serious liver damage can occur if you consume more than 3 alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.

en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have three or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.
bad_en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have five or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.
translation: アセトアミノフェンを使用中に1日5杯以上のアルコール飲料を摂取すると、重度の肝障害が発生する可能性があります。
back: Serious liver damage can occur if you consume more than 5 alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.

en: Oseltamivir and zanamivir are given twice a day for five days.
bad_en: Oseltamivir and zanamivir are given twice a day for ten days.
translation: オセルタミビルとザナミビルは、1 日 2 回、5 日間投与されます。
back: Oseltamivir and zanamivir are administered twice daily for 5 days.

en: Oseltamivir and zanamivir are given twice a day for five days.
bad_en: Oseltamivir and zanamivir are given twice a day for ten days.
translation: オセルタミビルとザナミビルは、1 日 2 回、10 日間投与されます。
back: Oseltamivir and zanamivir are administered twice daily for 10 days.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 2 months and older.
translation: ペラミビルは、6か月以上の人のインフルエンザの早期治療に承認されています。
back: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of influenza in people 6 months and older.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 2 months and older.
translation: ペラミビルは、生後 2 か月以上の人のインフルエンザの早期治療に承認されています。
back: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of influenza in people 2 months of age and older.

en: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated flu in people 5 years and older.
bad_en: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated flu in people 2 years and older.
translation: バロキサビルは、5 歳以上の単純なインフルエンザの早期治療に承認されています。
back: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated influenza in people 5 years of age and older.

en: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated flu in people 5 years and older.
bad_en: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated flu in people 2 years and older.
translation: バロキサビルは、2 歳以上の単純なインフルエンザの早期治療に承認されています。
back: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated influenza in people 2 years of age and older.

en: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 2 to 4 shots a day to reach their blood glucose targets.
bad_en: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 6 to 8 shots a day to reach their blood glucose targets.
translation: インスリンを服用している糖尿病患者の中には、血糖目標を達成するために 1 日 2 ～ 4 回の注射が必要な人もいます。
back: Some diabetics who take insulin may need two to four injections a day to reach their blood sugar goals.

en: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 2 to 4 shots a day to reach their blood glucose targets.
bad_en: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 6 to 8 shots a day to reach their blood glucose targets.
translation: インスリンを服用している糖尿病患者の中には、血糖目標に達するまでに 1 日 6 ～ 8 回の注射が必要な場合があります。
back: Some diabetics who take insulin may need six to eight injections a day to reach their blood sugar goals.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 102.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
translation: 生後 2 か月以下の乳児に華氏 100.4 度以上の発熱がある場合は、医師に連絡してください。
back: If your infant is 2 months old or younger and has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher, call your doctor.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 102.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
translation: 生後 2 か月以下の乳児に華氏 102.4 度以上の発熱がある場合は、医師に連絡してください。
back: If your infant is 2 months old or younger and has a fever of 102.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher, call your doctor.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 1.
translation: FDAは、2歳未満の子供の咳や風邪の症状に対して市販薬を推奨していません。
back: The FDA does not recommend over-the-counter medications for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 2 years.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 1.
translation: FDAは、1歳未満の子供の咳や風邪の症状に対して市販薬を推奨していません。
back: The FDA does not recommend over-the-counter medications for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 1 year.

en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms last.
bad_en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 2 hours while symptoms last.
translation: 大人および12歳以上の子供：症状が続いている間は6時間ごとに2カプレットを服用してください。
back: Adults and children 12 years and older: Take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms persist.

en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms last.
bad_en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 2 hours while symptoms last.
translation: 大人および12歳以上の子供：症状が続いている間は2時間ごとに2カプレットを服用してください。
back: Adults and children 12 years and older: Take 2 caplets every 2 hours while symptoms persist.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 10 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
translation: 医師の指示がない限り、24 時間以内に 6 カプレットを超えて服用しないでください。
back: Do not take more than 6 caplets in a 24-hour period unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 10 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
translation: 医師の指示がない限り、24 時間以内に 10 カプレットを超えて服用しないでください。
back: Do not take more than 10 caplets in a 24-hour period unless directed by your doctor.

en: The maximum amount of acetaminophen in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The maximum amount of acetaminophen in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 g for adults.
translation: 成人の場合、24 時間のアセトアミノフェンの最大量は 4,000 mg を超えてはなりません。
back: For adults, the maximum amount of acetaminophen in a 24-hour period should not exceed 4,000 mg.

en: The maximum amount of acetaminophen in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The maximum amount of acetaminophen in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 g for adults.
translation: 成人の場合、24 時間のアセトアミノフェンの最大量は 4,000 g を超えてはなりません。
back: For adults, the maximum amount of acetaminophen in a 24-hour period should not exceed 4,000 g.

en: Flu antiviral drugs are usually taken for five days.
bad_en: Flu antiviral drugs are usually taken for five weeks.
translation: インフルエンザの抗ウイルス薬は通常5日間服用します。
back: Antiviral drugs for influenza are usually taken for 5 days.

en: Flu antiviral drugs are usually taken for five days.
bad_en: Flu antiviral drugs are usually taken for five weeks.
translation: インフルエンザ抗ウイルス薬は通常 5 週間服用します。
back: Influenza antivirals are usually taken for 5 weeks.

en: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 days after flu symptoms begin.
bad_en: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 weeks after flu symptoms begin.
translation: 抗ウイルス薬は、インフルエンザの症状が出始めてから 1 ～ 2 日以内に開始すると最もよく効果を発揮します。
back: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 days after flu symptoms start.

en: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 days after flu symptoms begin.
bad_en: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 weeks after flu symptoms begin.
translation: 抗ウイルス薬は、インフルエンザの症状が出始めてから 1 ～ 2 週間以内に開始すると最もよく効果を発揮します。
back: Antiviral drugs are most effective when started within 1 to 2 weeks after flu symptoms start.

en: Premixed insulin starts to work in 15 to 60 minutes and can last from 10 to 16 hours.
bad_en: Premixed insulin starts to work in 15 to 60 hours and can last from 10 to 16 hours.
translation: プレミックスインスリンは 15 ～ 60 分で効き始め、10 ～ 16 時間持続します。
back: Premixed insulin starts working in 15 to 60 minutes and lasts 10 to 16 hours.

en: Premixed insulin starts to work in 15 to 60 minutes and can last from 10 to 16 hours.
bad_en: Premixed insulin starts to work in 15 to 60 hours and can last from 10 to 16 hours.
translation: プレミックスインスリンは 15 ～ 60 時間で効果が現れ始め、10 ～ 16 時間持続します。
back: Premixed insulin begins to take effect in 15 to 60 hours and lasts for 10 to 16 hours.

en: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each week can help you manage your blood glucose level.
bad_en: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each day can help you manage your blood glucose level.
translation: 妊娠糖尿病の場合は、毎週 150 分間の早歩きが血糖値の管理に役立ちます。
back: If you have gestational diabetes, 150 minutes of brisk walking each week can help manage your blood sugar levels.

en: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each week can help you manage your blood glucose level.
bad_en: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each day can help you manage your blood glucose level.
translation: 妊娠糖尿病の場合は、毎日 150 分間の早歩きが血糖値の管理に役立ちます。
back: If you have gestational diabetes, 150 minutes of brisk walking each day can help manage your blood sugar levels.

en: The plastic tube of an insulin pump stays inserted for several days.
bad_en: The plastic tube of an insulin pump stays inserted for several hours.
translation: インスリンポンプのプラスチックチューブは数日間挿入されたままになります。
back: The plastic tube of your insulin pump will remain inserted for several days.

en: The plastic tube of an insulin pump stays inserted for several days.
bad_en: The plastic tube of an insulin pump stays inserted for several hours.
translation: インスリンポンプのプラスチックチューブは数時間挿入されたままになります。
back: The insulin pump's plastic tube remains inserted for several hours.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 weeks for pain unless directed by a doctor.
translation: 医師の指示がない限り、痛みがある場合は10日を超えて使用しないでください。
back: Do not use for more than 10 days if you have pain unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 weeks for pain unless directed by a doctor.
translation: 医師の指示がない限り、痛みがある場合は10週間を超えて使用しないでください。
back: Do not use for more than 10 weeks if you have pain unless directed by your doctor.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 weeks.
translation: 発熱が悪化した場合、または 3 日以上続いた場合は使用を中止し、医師の診察を受けてください。
back: If your fever worsens or persists for more than 3 days, discontinue use and seek medical advice.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 weeks.
translation: 発熱が悪化した場合、または 3 週間以上続く場合は、使用を中止し、医師の診察を受けてください。
back: If fever worsens or persists for more than 3 weeks, discontinue use and seek medical attention.

en: Call a doctor if an infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Celsius or higher.
translation: 乳児の発熱が華氏 100.4 度以上の場合は、医師に連絡してください。
back: If your infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher, call your doctor.

en: Call a doctor if an infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Celsius or higher.
translation: 乳児の発熱が 100.4 度以上の場合は、医師に連絡してください。
back: If your infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees or higher, call your doctor.

en: Taking medicines on an empty stomach generally means taking your pills at least two hours before you eat.
bad_en: Taking medicines on an empty stomach generally means taking your pills at least two minutes before you eat.
translation: 空腹時に薬を服用するということは、通常、食事の少なくとも 2 時間前に薬を服用することを意味します。
back: Taking your medication on an empty stomach usually means taking your medication at least 2 hours before a meal.

en: Taking medicines on an empty stomach generally means taking your pills at least two hours before you eat.
bad_en: Taking medicines on an empty stomach generally means taking your pills at least two minutes before you eat.
translation: 空腹時に薬を服用するということは、通常、食事の少なくとも 2 分前に薬を服用することを意味します。
back: Taking your medication on an empty stomach usually means taking your medication at least 2 minutes before a meal.

en: Do not use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.
bad_en: Use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.
translation: 一度に複数のアセトアミノフェン含有製品を使用しないでください。
back: Do not use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at the same time.

en: Do not use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.
bad_en: Use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.
translation: 一度に複数のアセトアミノフェン含有製品を使用してください。
back: Use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.

en: Never take more acetaminophen than what the label says, even if you still have fever or pain.
bad_en: Take more acetaminophen than what the label says if you still have fever or pain.
translation: たとえまだ熱や痛みがある場合でも、ラベルに記載されている以上にアセトアミノフェンを服用しないでください。
back: Do not take more acetaminophen than recommended on the label, even if you still have fever or pain.

en: Never take more acetaminophen than what the label says, even if you still have fever or pain.
bad_en: Take more acetaminophen than what the label says if you still have fever or pain.
translation: それでも発熱や痛みがある場合は、ラベルに記載されている量よりも多くのアセトアミノフェンを摂取してください。
back: If you still have fever or pain, take more acetaminophen than the amount listed on the label.

en: Do not use a product intended for adults if the child is less than 12 years of age.
bad_en: Use a product intended for adults if the child is less than 12 years of age.
translation: お子様が 12 歳未満の場合は、成人向けの製品を使用しないでください。
back: If your child is under 12 years of age, do not use products intended for adults.

en: Do not use a product intended for adults if the child is less than 12 years of age.
bad_en: Use a product intended for adults if the child is less than 12 years of age.
translation: お子様が 12 歳未満の場合は、成人向けの製品を使用してください。
back: If your child is under 12 years of age, use products intended for adults.

en: If giving liquid acetaminophen, do not use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device from a different product.
bad_en: If giving liquid acetaminophen, use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device from a different product.
translation: 液体アセトアミノフェンを与える場合は、キッチンスプーンや別の製品の投与装置を使用しないでください。
back: When giving liquid acetaminophen, do not use a kitchen spoon or another product administration device.

en: If giving liquid acetaminophen, do not use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device from a different product.
bad_en: If giving liquid acetaminophen, use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device from a different product.
translation: 液体のアセトアミノフェンを与える場合は、キッチンスプーンまたは別の製品の投与装置を使用してください。
back: If giving liquid acetaminophen, use a kitchen spoon or another product administration device.

en: Do not stop taking any prescribed drugs without first talking to your health care professional.
bad_en: Stop taking any prescribed drugs without first talking to your health care professional.
translation: 最初に医療専門家に相談することなく、処方薬の服用を中止しないでください。
back: Do not stop taking any prescription medications without first consulting your health care professional.

en: Do not stop taking any prescribed drugs without first talking to your health care professional.
bad_en: Stop taking any prescribed drugs without first talking to your health care professional.
translation: まずは医療専門家に相談せずに、処方薬の服用を中止してください。
back: Stop taking any prescription medications without first consulting your health care professional.

en: When flying, carry your medicines with you; do not pack them in your checked luggage.
bad_en: When flying, do not carry your medicines with you; pack them in your checked luggage.
translation: 飛行機に乗るときは、薬を持ち歩きましょう。受託手荷物の中に入れないでください。
back: Carry your medicine with you when you fly. Do not put it in checked baggage.

en: When flying, carry your medicines with you; do not pack them in your checked luggage.
bad_en: When flying, do not carry your medicines with you; pack them in your checked luggage.
translation: 飛行機に乗るときは、薬を持ち込まないでください。受託手荷物に詰めてください。
back: When you fly, don't bring your medicine with you. Pack it in your checked baggage.

en: Do not chew, break, or crush tablets without first asking if this will change the way the drug works.
bad_en: Chew, break, or crush tablets without first asking if this will change the way the drug works.
translation: 薬の作用が変わるかどうかを最初に尋ねずに、錠剤を噛んだり、割ったり、砕いたりしないでください。
back: Do not chew, split, or crush your tablets without first asking whether it will change the way your medicine works.

en: Do not chew, break, or crush tablets without first asking if this will change the way the drug works.
bad_en: Chew, break, or crush tablets without first asking if this will change the way the drug works.
translation: 薬の作用が変わるかどうかを最初に尋ねずに、錠剤を噛んだり、割ったり、砕いたりしてください。
back: Don't chew, split, or crush any tablets without first asking if it changes the way the drug works.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
bad_en: Baloxavir is recommended for treatment of flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
translation: バロキサビルは、妊娠中または授乳中のインフルエンザの治療には推奨されません。
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for the treatment of influenza during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
bad_en: Baloxavir is recommended for treatment of flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
translation: バロキサビルは、妊娠中または授乳中のインフルエンザの治療に推奨されます。
back: Baloxavir is recommended for the treatment of influenza during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

en: Even if you are feeling better, you should not stop taking your prescription drug unless your doctor says it's okay.
bad_en: Even if you are not feeling better, you should stop taking your prescription drug unless your doctor says it's okay.
translation: たとえ気分が良くなったとしても、医師が大丈夫だと言うまでは、処方薬の服用をやめてはいけません。
back: Even if you feel better, don't stop taking your prescription medication until your doctor says it's okay.

en: Even if you are feeling better, you should not stop taking your prescription drug unless your doctor says it's okay.
bad_en: Even if you are not feeling better, you should stop taking your prescription drug unless your doctor says it's okay.
translation: たとえ気分が良くなかったとしても、医師が大丈夫だと言わない限り、処方薬の服用を中止する必要があります。
back: Even if you don't feel well, you should stop taking your prescription medication unless your doctor says it's okay.

en: Don't crush pills before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.
bad_en: Crush the pills before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.
translation: 錠剤を土、猫砂、または使用済みのコーヒーかすと混ぜる前に粉砕しないでください。
back: Do not crush the tablets before mixing them with soil, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.

en: Don't crush pills before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.
bad_en: Crush the pills before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.
translation: 錠剤を土、猫砂、または使用済みのコーヒーかすと混ぜる前に粉砕してください。
back: Crush the tablets before mixing them with soil, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.

en: Flu antiviral drugs should ideally be started within two days after becoming sick.
bad_en: Flu antiviral drugs should ideally be started only after two days of being sick.
translation: インフルエンザ抗ウイルス薬は、発症後 2 日以内に投与を開始するのが理想的です。
back: Ideally, influenza antivirals should be started within 2 days of the onset of symptoms.

en: Flu antiviral drugs should ideally be started within two days after becoming sick.
bad_en: Flu antiviral drugs should ideally be started only after two days of being sick.
translation: インフルエンザ抗ウイルス薬は、理想的には病気になってから 2 日後に服用を開始する必要があります。
back: Influenza antivirals should ideally be started two days after becoming ill.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional after use if you have liver disease.
translation: 肝臓疾患がある場合は、使用前に医療専門家に相談してください。
back: If you have liver disease, consult your health care professional before use.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional after use if you have liver disease.
translation: 肝臓疾患がある場合は、使用後に医師に相談してください。
back: If you have liver disease, consult your doctor after use.

en: Check the label on your medicine before leaving the pharmacy.
bad_en: Check the label on your medicine after leaving the pharmacy.
translation: 薬局を出る前に、薬のラベルを確認してください。
back: Check the label of your medicine before leaving the pharmacy.

en: Check the label on your medicine before leaving the pharmacy.
bad_en: Check the label on your medicine after leaving the pharmacy.
translation: 薬局を出たら、薬のラベルを確認してください。
back: When you leave the pharmacy, check the label on your medicine.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children older than 2.
translation: FDAは、2歳未満の子供に市販の咳止め薬や風邪薬を推奨していません。
back: The FDA does not recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children under 2 years of age.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children older than 2.
translation: FDAは、2歳以上の子供に市販の咳止め薬や風邪薬を推奨していません。
back: The FDA does not recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children over 2 years of age.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
translation: 生後 2 か月以下の乳児に華氏 100.4 度以上の発熱がある場合は、医師に連絡してください。
back: If your infant is 2 months old or younger and has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher, call your doctor.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
translation: 生後 2 か月以下の乳児の発熱が華氏 100.4 度以下の場合は、医師に連絡してください。
back: If your infant is 2 months old or younger and has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or less, call your doctor.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and younger.
translation: ペラミビルは、6か月以上の人のインフルエンザの早期治療に承認されています。
back: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of influenza in people 6 months and older.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and younger.
translation: ペラミビルは、生後6か月以下の人のインフルエンザの早期治療に承認されています。
back: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of influenza in people 6 months of age and younger.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days.
translation: 発熱が悪化した場合、または 3 日以上続いた場合は使用を中止し、医師の診察を受けてください。
back: If your fever worsens or persists for more than 3 days, discontinue use and seek medical advice.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days.
translation: 発熱が悪化する場合、または発熱が 3 日未満続く場合は、使用を中止し、医師の診察を受けてください。
back: If your fever worsens or persists for less than 3 days, discontinue use and seek medical attention.

en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.
translation: 成人の場合、24時間に摂取するアセトアミノフェンの総量は4,000mgを超えてはなりません。
back: For adults, the total amount of acetaminophen taken in a 24-hour period should not exceed 4,000 mg.

en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.
translation: 成人の場合、24時間に摂取するアセトアミノフェンの総量は4,000mgを下回ってはなりません。
back: For adults, the total amount of acetaminophen taken in a 24-hour period should not be less than 4,000 mg.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: 旅行する場合は、出発前に薬のスケジュールの変更について医師または薬剤師に相談してください。
back: If you are traveling, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changing your medication schedule before you leave.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: 旅行する場合は、帰国後の薬のスケジュールの変更について医師または薬剤師に相談してください。
back: If you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changing your medication schedule when you return.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: アセトアミノフェンを過剰に摂取したと思われる場合は、すぐに医師の診察を受けてください。
back: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, seek immediate medical attention.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: アセトアミノフェンの摂取量が少なすぎると思われる場合は、すぐに医師の診察を受けてください。
back: If you think you are taking too little acetaminophen, see your doctor right away.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: 医師の指示がない限り、24 時間以内に 6 カプレットを超えて服用しないでください。
back: Do not take more than 6 caplets in a 24-hour period unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: 医師の指示があっても、24 時間以内に 6 カプレットを超えて服用しないでください。
back: Do not take more than 6 caplets in a 24-hour period, even if directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: 医師の指示がない限り、痛みがある場合は10日を超えて使用しないでください。
back: Do not use for more than 10 days if you have pain unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: 医師の指示がある場合は、痛みがある場合は10日を超えて使用しないでください。
back: If directed by your doctor, do not use for more than 10 days if you have pain.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: 妊娠中または授乳中の場合は、使用前に医療専門家にご相談ください。
back: If pregnant or breastfeeding, consult a health care professional before use.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: 妊娠中または授乳中でない場合は、使用前に医療専門家に相談してください。
back: If you are not pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your health care professional before use.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: 過去にアセトアミノフェンを問題なく服用していたとしても、重篤な皮膚反応が発生する可能性があります。
back: Even if you have taken acetaminophen without problems in the past, serious skin reactions can occur.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: 重篤な皮膚反応は、これまでにアセトアミノフェンを服用したことがない場合にのみ発生する可能性があります。
back: Serious skin reactions may only occur if you have never taken acetaminophen before.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: アセトアミノフェンを含む薬剤の使用中に皮膚に発疹が生じた場合は、薬剤の使用を中止し、直ちに医師の診察を受けてください。
back: If you develop a skin rash while using a drug containing acetaminophen, stop using the drug and seek immediate medical attention.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: アセトアミノフェンを含む薬剤の使用中に皮膚に発疹が生じた場合を除き、薬剤の使用を中止し、直ちに医師の診察を受けてください。
back: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a drug containing acetaminophen, stop using the drug and seek immediate medical attention.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: フラッシュリストに記載されていない薬は流さないでください。
back: Do not flush any medications that are not on the flush list.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: フラッシュリストに記載されている薬は流さないでください。
back: Do not flush any medications listed on the flush list.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: 処方箋のない咳止めや風邪薬は、推奨用量を超えて摂取すると子供に有害となる可能性があります。
back: Nonprescription cough and cold medicines can be harmful to children if taken in higher than recommended doses.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: 処方箋のない咳止めや風邪薬は、推奨用量を超えて摂取しない限り、子供に有害となる可能性があります。
back: Nonprescription cough and cold medicines can be harmful to children unless taken in higher than recommended doses.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: 肝臓疾患がある場合は、使用前に医療専門家に相談してください。
back: If you have liver disease, consult your health care professional before use.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: 肝疾患がない限り、使用前に医療専門家に相談してください。
back: Consult a health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: アセトアミノフェンにより重度の皮膚反応を起こしたことがある場合は、アセトアミノフェンを含む製品を二度と摂取しないでください。
back: If you have ever had a severe skin reaction from acetaminophen, never take any products containing acetaminophen again.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: アセトアミノフェンにより重篤な皮膚反応を起こしたことがない限り、アセトアミノフェンを含む製品を二度と摂取しないでください。
back: Never take acetaminophen-containing products again unless you have had a serious skin reaction from acetaminophen.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: CDCは、インフルエンザに罹患しており、重篤なインフルエンザ合併症のリスクが高い人には迅速な治療を推奨しています。
back: The CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have the flu and are at high risk for serious flu complications.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: CDCは、インフルエンザに罹患している人、または重篤なインフルエンザ合併症のリスクが高い人に対しては、迅速な治療を推奨しています。
back: The CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have the flu or are at high risk for serious flu complications.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: 吸入インスリンは、1 型または 2 型糖尿病の成人のみが対象です。
back: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: 吸入インスリンは、1 型または 2 型糖尿病の小児にのみ使用できます。
back: Inhaled insulin can only be used in children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: 人工膵臓は、主に 1 型糖尿病患者を助けるために使用されます。
back: Artificial pancreas is primarily used to help patients with type 1 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: 人工膵臓は主に 2 型糖尿病患者を助けるために使用されます。
back: Artificial pancreas is primarily used to help patients with type 2 diabetes.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: オセルタミビルは、出生時から小児のインフルエンザの治療にCDCによって推奨されています。
back: Oseltamivir is recommended by the CDC for the treatment of influenza in children from birth.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: オセルタミビルは、CDC によって 65 歳以上の成人のインフルエンザ治療に推奨されています。
back: Oseltamivir is recommended by the CDC for the treatment of influenza in adults age 65 and older.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: 錠剤を飲み込むのが難しい場合は、薬剤師に伝えてください。
back: Tell your pharmacist if you have difficulty swallowing your tablets.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: 錠剤を飲み込むのが難しい場合は、薬剤師が教えてくれます。
back: Your pharmacist will tell you if you have difficulty swallowing your tablets.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: 処方箋ラベルに記載されている用語や略語について理解できない場合は、薬剤師に説明を求めてください。
back: If you do not understand a term or abbreviation on your prescription label, ask your pharmacist for clarification.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: 薬剤師は、処方箋ラベルに記載されている理解できない用語や略語について説明するよう求めます。
back: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations you don't understand on your prescription label.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: 医療専門家は、あなたが深刻な皮膚反応を起こしているかどうかを判断するためにあなたを評価する必要があります。
back: A medical professional will need to evaluate you to determine if you are having a serious skin reaction.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: 深刻な皮膚反応が発生しているかどうかを判断するには、自分自身を評価する必要があります。
back: You must evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: あなたが服用しているすべての薬、ビタミン、サプリメントについて医療専門家に知らせてください。
back: Tell your health care professional about all the medicines, vitamins, and supplements you take.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: あなたの医療専門家は、あなたが服用しているすべての薬、ビタミン、サプリメントについて知らせます。
back: Your health care professional will let you know about all medications, vitamins, and supplements you are taking.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: 線量の測定方法が不明な場合は、お子様の医療専門家に問い合わせてください。
back: If you are unsure how to measure dose, ask your child's health care professional.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: 線量の測定方法がわからない場合は、お子様の医療専門家があなたに連絡します。
back: If you are unsure how to measure the dose, your child's health care professional will contact you.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: バロキサビルは入院患者のインフルエンザの治療には推奨されません。
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for the treatment of influenza in hospitalized patients.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: バロキサビルは外来でのインフルエンザの治療には推奨されません。
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for outpatient treatment of influenza.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: 他人に処方された薬を服用しないでください。
back: Do not take medicines prescribed by someone else.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: 処方された薬は服用しないでください。
back: Do not take prescribed medicines.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: 債務検証情報を受け取ったら、30 日以内に書面で債務に異議を申し立てることができます。
back: Once you receive your debt verification information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: 債務検証情報を受け取ったら、60 日以内に書面で債務に異議を申し立てることができます。
back: Once you receive your debt verification information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: この情報は、債権回収者との最初の連絡から 5 日以内に書面による通知で提供されます。
back: This information will be provided to you in written notice within five days of your first contact with the debt collector.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: この情報は、債権回収者との最初の連絡から 15 日以内に書面による通知で提供されます。
back: This information will be provided to you in written notice within 15 days of your first contact with the debt collector.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: SSI に影響を与える可能性のある変更は、変更が発生した月末から 10 日以内に報告してください。
back: Please report any changes that may affect your SSI within 10 days of the end of the month in which the change occurs.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: SSI に影響を与える可能性のある変更は、変更が発生した月末から 30 日以内に報告してください。
back: Please report any changes that may affect your SSI within 30 days of the end of the month in which the change occurs.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: 変更の報告を怠った場合、SSI の支払いを 25 ドルから 100 ドル減額するペナルティが適用される場合があります。
back: If you fail to report the change, you may be subject to a penalty that reduces your SSI payment by $25 to $100.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: 変更の報告を怠った場合、SSI の支払いを 250 ドルから 1,000 ドル減額するペナルティが適用される場合があります。

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
bad_en: Unless the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
translation: 売り手があなたに商品を与えた場合、あなたはそれらを受け取った時と同じくらい良い状態で売り手に提供しなければなりません。

back: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is extended to 300 days only if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination and a state agency to enforce that law.

en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, and filed all required returns.
bad_en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, or filed all required returns.
translation: 税金、罰金、利息を合わせた支払い額が 50,000 ドル以下で、必要な申告書をすべて提出している場合は、オンラインで申請する資格があります。
back: If you owe $50,000 or less in combined taxes, penalties, and interest, and you have filed all required returns, you are eligible to apply online.

en: If you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
bad_en: Unless you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.

en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, unless your card expires before your 16th birthday.
bad_en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, if your card expires before your 16th birthday.
translation: 14 歳になる前にカードを受け取った場合は、16 歳の誕生日前にカードの有効期限が切れない限り、14 歳になったらカードを交換する必要があります。

en: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults and children 12 years of age and older.
bad_en: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 6,000 mg for adults and children 12 years of age and older.
translation: 24시간 동안 복용하는 아세트아미노펜의 최대 총량은 성인과 12세 이상 어린이의 경우 4,000mg을 넘지 않아야 합니다.
back: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not exceed 4,000 mg for adults and children over 12 years of age.

en: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults and children 12 years of age and older.
bad_en: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 6,000 mg for adults and children 12 years of age and older.
translation: 24시간 동안 복용하는 아세트아미노펜의 최대 총량은 성인과 12세 이상 어린이의 경우 6,000mg을 넘지 않아야 합니다.
back: The maximum total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not exceed 6,000 mg for adults and children over 12 years of age.

en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have three or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.
bad_en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have five or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.
translation: 아세트아미노펜을 사용하는 동안 하루에 3잔 이상의 알코올 음료를 마시면 심각한 간 손상이 발생할 수 있습니다.

en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have three or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.
