en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and younger.
translation: Peramivir는 6개월 이하의 독감 조기 치료용으로 승인되었습니다.
back: Peramivir is approved for the early treatment of influenza in children up to 6 months of age.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days.
translation: 발열이 심해지거나 3일 이상 지속되면 사용을 중단하고 의사와 상담하세요.
back: If fever worsens or persists for more than 3 days, discontinue use and consult a doctor.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days.
translation: 발열이 심해지거나 3일 미만 지속되는 경우에는 사용을 중지하고 의사에게 문의하십시오.
back: If fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days, discontinue use and consult a doctor.

en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.
translation: 성인의 경우 24시간 동안 복용하는 아세트아미노펜 총량이 4,000mg을 넘지 않아야 합니다.
back: For adults, the total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not exceed 4,000 mg.

en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.
translation: 성인의 경우 24시간 동안 복용하는 아세트아미노펜 총량이 4,000mg 이상이어야 합니다.
back: For adults, the total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should be more than 4,000 mg.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: 여행할 때는 출발하기 전에 약 복용 일정 변경에 대해 의사나 약사에게 문의하세요.
back: When traveling, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changing your medication schedule before you leave.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: 여행할 때, 귀국 후 약 복용 일정 변경에 대해 의사나 약사에게 문의하세요.
back: When traveling, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changing your medication schedule when you return home.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: 아세트아미노펜을 너무 많이 복용했다고 생각되면 즉시 의료 도움을 받으십시오.
back: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: 아세트아미노펜을 너무 적게 복용했다고 생각되면 즉시 의학적 도움을 받으십시오.
back: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: 의사의 지시가 없는 한 24시간 내에 6정을 초과하여 복용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: 의사의 지시가 있더라도 24시간 내에 6정을 초과하여 복용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not take more than 6 tablets within 24 hours, even if directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: 의사의 지시가 없는 한 통증이 있는 경우 10일 이상 사용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not use for more than 10 days if you have pain unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: 의사의 지시가 있는 경우 통증이 있는 경우 10일 이상 사용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not use for more than 10 days if you have pain, as directed by your doctor.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: 임신 중이거나 모유 수유 중인 경우, 사용하기 전에 의료 전문가에게 문의하십시오.
back: If pregnant or breastfeeding, consult a healthcare professional before use.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: 임신 중이거나 수유 중인 경우를 제외하고 사용하기 전에 의료 전문가에게 문의하세요.
back: Consult your healthcare professional before use, except if pregnant or breastfeeding.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: 과거에 아세트아미노펜을 아무런 문제 없이 복용했더라도 심각한 피부 반응이 발생할 수 있습니다.
back: Even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems, you may develop a serious skin reaction.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: 심각한 피부 반응은 이전에 아세트아미노펜을 복용한 적이 없는 경우에만 발생할 수 있습니다.
back: A serious skin reaction may only occur if you have never taken acetaminophen before.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: 아세트아미노펜이 함유된 약을 사용하는 동안 피부 발진이 나타나면 약을 중단하고 즉시 의사의 진료를 받으십시오.
back: If you develop a skin rash while using medicine containing acetaminophen, stop taking the medicine and seek immediate medical attention.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: 아세트아미노펜이 함유된 약을 사용하는 동안 피부 발진이 발생하지 않는 한, 약을 중단하고 즉시 의사의 진료를 받으십시오.
back: Unless you develop a skin rash while using medicine containing acetaminophen, stop taking the medicine and seek immediate medical attention.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: 세척 목록에 없는 약은 세척하지 마십시오.
back: Do not wash medications that are not on the cleaning list.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: 세척 목록에 있는 약은 세척하지 마십시오.
back: Do not wash medications that are on the wash list.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: 비처방 기침 및 감기 제품은 권장 복용량보다 많이 섭취할 경우 어린이에게 해로울 수 있습니다.
back: Over-the-counter cough and cold products may be harmful to children if taken in higher than recommended doses.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: 비처방 기침 및 감기 제품은 권장 복용량 이상을 섭취하지 않는 한 어린이에게 해로울 수 있습니다.
back: Non-prescription cough and cold products may be harmful to children unless they take more than the recommended dose.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: 간 질환이 있는 경우 사용하기 전에 의료 전문가에게 문의하십시오.
back: If you have liver disease, ask your health care professional before use.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: 간 질환이 있는 경우를 제외하고는 사용하기 전에 의료 전문가에게 문의하십시오.
back: Ask your healthcare professional before use, unless you have liver disease.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: 아세트아미노펜으로 인해 심각한 피부 반응이 발생한 경우, 다시는 아세트아미노펜이 함유된 제품을 복용하지 마세요.
back: If you have a serious skin reaction from acetaminophen, never take products containing acetaminophen again.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: 아세트아미노펜으로 인해 심각한 피부 반응이 발생한 경우를 제외하고는 아세트아미노펜이 함유된 제품을 다시 복용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not take products containing acetaminophen again unless you have had a serious skin reaction from acetaminophen.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: CDC는 독감에 걸렸고 심각한 독감 합병증에 걸릴 위험이 높은 사람들에게 즉각적인 치료를 권장합니다.
back: CDC recommends immediate treatment for people who have the flu and are at high risk for serious flu complications.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: CDC는 독감에 걸렸거나 심각한 독감 합병증에 걸릴 위험이 높은 사람들에게 즉각적인 치료를 권장합니다.
back: CDC recommends immediate treatment for people who have the flu or are at high risk for serious flu complications.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: 흡입 인슐린은 제1형 또는 제2형 당뇨병이 있는 성인에게만 해당됩니다.
back: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: 흡입 인슐린은 제1형 또는 제2형 당뇨병 아동에게만 해당됩니다.
back: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: 인공 췌장은 주로 제1형 당뇨병 환자를 돕는 데 사용됩니다.
back: Artificial pancreas is primarily used to help people with type 1 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: 인공 췌장은 주로 제2형 당뇨병 환자를 돕는 데 사용됩니다.
back: Artificial pancreas is primarily used to help people with type 2 diabetes.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: 오셀타미비르는 출생 시부터 어린이의 독감 치료를 위해 CDC에서 권장됩니다.
back: Oseltamivir is recommended by the CDC for the treatment of influenza in children starting at birth.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: 오셀타미비르는 65세부터 성인의 독감 치료를 위해 CDC에서 권장됩니다.
back: Oseltamivir is recommended by the CDC for the treatment of flu in adults starting age 65.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: 알약을 삼키는 데 어려움이 있으면 약사에게 알리십시오.
back: If you have trouble swallowing your pills, tell your pharmacist.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: 약을 삼키는 데 어려움이 있으면 약사가 알려줄 것입니다.
back: Your pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing your medicine.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: 귀하가 이해하지 못하는 처방전 라벨의 용어나 약어에 대해 약사에게 설명하도록 요청하십시오.
back: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you do not understand.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: 약사는 처방전 라벨에 있는 자신이 이해하지 못하는 용어나 약어에 대해 설명하도록 요청할 것입니다.
back: Your pharmacist may ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you do not understand.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: 의료 전문가는 귀하가 심각한 피부 반응을 겪고 있는지 판단하기 위해 귀하를 평가해야 합니다.
back: A medical professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: 심각한 피부 반응이 나타나는지 확인하려면 스스로 평가해야 합니다.
back: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: 복용하는 모든 약, 비타민, 보충제에 대해 담당 의료 전문가에게 알리십시오.
back: Tell your health care professional about all medications, vitamins, and supplements you take.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: 귀하의 의료 전문가는 귀하가 복용하는 모든 약, 비타민 및 보충제에 대해 알려줄 것입니다.
back: Your health care professional will tell you about all medications, vitamins, and supplements you take.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: 복용량을 측정하는 방법을 잘 모르는 경우 자녀의 건강 관리 전문가에게 문의하십시오.
back: If you are not sure how to measure the dosage, ask your child's health care professional.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: 복용량을 측정하는 방법을 잘 모르는 경우 자녀의 건강 관리 전문가가 귀하에게 연락할 것입니다.
back: If you are not sure how to measure the dosage, your child's health care professional will contact you.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: 발록사비르는 입원 환자의 독감 치료에 권장되지 않습니다.
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for treating influenza in hospitalized patients.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: 발록사비르는 외래환자의 독감 치료에 권장되지 않습니다.
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for the treatment of flu in outpatients.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: 다른 사람에게 처방된 약을 복용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not take medications prescribed for you by someone else.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: 귀하에게 처방된 약을 복용하지 마십시오.
back: Do not take the medicine prescribed for you.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: 부채 확인 정보를 받으면 30일 이내에 서면으로 부채에 대해 이의를 제기할 수 있습니다.
back: Once you receive the debt verification information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: 부채 확인 정보를 받으면 60일 이내에 서면으로 부채에 대해 이의를 제기할 수 있습니다.
back: Once you receive the debt verification information, you may dispute the debt in writing within 60 days.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: 이 정보는 추심자가 귀하에게 처음 연락한 후 5일 이내에 서면 통지로 제공됩니다.
back: This information will be provided in written notice within 5 days of the collector first contacting you.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: 이 정보는 추심자가 귀하에게 처음 연락한 날로부터 15일 이내에 서면 통지로 제공됩니다.
back: This information will be provided in written notice within 15 days of the debt collector first contacting you.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: 귀하의 SSI에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 모든 변경 사항은 변경이 발생한 달의 말일로부터 10일 이내에 보고하십시오.
back: Report any changes that may affect your SSI within 10 days of the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: 귀하의 SSI에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 모든 변경 사항은 변경이 발생한 달의 말일로부터 30일 이내에 보고하십시오.
back: Report any changes that may affect your SSI within 30 days of the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: 변경 사항을 보고하지 않을 때마다 SSI 지급액이 $25~$100씩 삭감되는 벌금이 부과될 수 있습니다.
back: For each change you fail to report, you may be subject to a penalty that reduces your SSI payment by $25 to $100.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: 변경 사항을 보고하지 않을 때마다 SSI 지급액이 $250에서 $1,000까지 삭감되는 벌금이 부과될 수 있습니다.
back: Each time you fail to report a change, you may be subject to a penalty that reduces your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000.

en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 6 months.
bad_en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 3 months.
translation: 첫 번째 제재 기간은 6개월 동안 지급을 보류하는 것입니다.
back: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for six months.

en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 6 months.
bad_en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 3 months.

bad_en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have five or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.
translation: 如果您在使用对乙酰氨基酚时每天饮用三杯或三杯以上酒精饮料，可能会发生严重的肝损伤。
back: Serious liver damage may occur if you drink three or more alcoholic drinks a day while using acetaminophen.

back: If an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 102.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher, call the doctor.

bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 1.
translation: FDA 不建议 2 岁以下儿童使用非处方药来治疗咳嗽和感冒症状。
back: The FDA does not recommend the use of over-the-counter medications to treat cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 2 years of age.

en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms last.
bad_en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 2 hours while symptoms last.
translation: 成人和 12 岁及以上儿童：症状持续期间每 6 小时服用 2 粒。

back: Adults and children 12 years and older: Take 2 capsules every 2 hours while symptoms persist.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 10 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.

bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children older than 2.
translation: FDA 不建议 2 岁以下儿童使用非处方止咳药和感冒药。
back: The FDA does not recommend the use of over-the-counter cough and cold medicines in children under 2 years of age.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children older than 2.
translation: FDA 不建议 2 岁以上儿童使用非处方止咳药和感冒药。
back: The FDA does not recommend the use of over-the-counter cough and cold medicines in children over 2 years of age.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
translation: 如果 2 个月或更小的婴儿发烧 100.4 华氏度或更高，请致电医生。
back: If an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher, call the doctor.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
translation: 如果 2 个月或更小的婴儿发烧 100.4 华氏度或更低，请致电医生。
back: If an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or lower, call the doctor.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and younger.
translation: 帕拉米韦被批准用于 6 个月及以上人群的流感早期治疗。
back: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of influenza in people 6 months of age and older.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and younger.
translation: 帕拉米韦被批准用于 6 个月及以下人群的流感早期治疗。
back: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of influenza in people 6 months of age and younger.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days.
translation: 如果发烧加剧或持续超过 3 天，请停止使用并咨询医生。
back: If fever worsens or persists for more than 3 days, discontinue use and consult a physician.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days.
translation: 如果发烧加剧或持续时间少于 3 天，请停止使用并咨询医生。
back: If fever worsens or lasts less than 3 days, discontinue use and consult a physician.

en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.
translation: 成人24小时内服用对乙酰氨基酚的总量不应超过4000毫克。
back: Adults should not take more than 4,000 mg of acetaminophen in a 24-hour period.

en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.
translation: 成人24小时内服用对乙酰氨基酚的总量不应少于4000毫克。
back: The total amount of acetaminophen taken by adults in a 24-hour period should not be less than 4,000 mg.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: 当您旅行时，请在出发前询问您的医生或药剂师您的用药时间表的变化。
back: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medication schedule before departure.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: 当您旅行时，请向您的医生或药剂师询问您返回后用药安排的变化。
back: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes in your medication schedule upon your return.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: 如果您认为自己服用了过多的对乙酰氨基酚，请立即寻求医疗帮助。
back: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: 如果您认为自己服用的对乙酰氨基酚太少，请立即寻求医疗帮助。
back: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: 除非医生指示，否则 24 小时内请勿服用超过 6 粒胶囊。
back: Do not take more than 6 capsules in 24 hours unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: 即使在医生指导下，24 小时内也不要服用超过 6 粒胶囊。
back: Do not take more than 6 capsules in 24 hours, even under your doctor's direction.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: 除非医生指示，否则不要因疼痛而使用超过 10 天。
back: Do not use due to pain for more than 10 days unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: 如果在医生指导下使用，请勿因疼痛而使用超过 10 天。
back: If used under a doctor's supervision, do not use for more than 10 days due to pain.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: 如果怀孕或哺乳，请在使用前咨询健康专业人士。
back: If pregnant or nursing, consult a health professional before use.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: 除非怀孕或哺乳，否则请在使用前咨询健康专业人士。
back: Unless pregnant or nursing, consult a health professional before use.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: 即使您过去服用对乙酰氨基酚没有任何问题，也可能会发生严重的皮肤反应。
back: Even if you have taken acetaminophen without any problems in the past, you may develop a serious skin reaction.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: 仅当您以前从未服用过对乙酰氨基酚时，才会发生严重的皮肤反应。
back: A serious skin reaction can only occur if you have never taken acetaminophen before.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: 如果您在使用含有对乙酰氨基酚的药物时出现皮疹，请立即停止用药并就医。
back: If you develop a rash while using a medicine containing acetaminophen, stop taking the medicine immediately and seek medical advice.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: 除非您在使用含有对乙酰氨基酚的药物时出现皮疹，否则请立即停止用药并就医。
back: Unless you develop a rash while using a medicine containing acetaminophen, stop taking the medicine immediately and seek medical advice.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: 除非在冲洗清单上，否则不要冲洗任何药物。
back: Do not flush any medication unless it is on the flushing list.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: 如果药物在冲洗清单上，请勿冲洗。
back: Do not flush if the medication is on the flush list.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: 如果儿童服用非处方咳嗽和感冒产品超过推荐剂量，可能会对儿童有害。
back: Over-the-counter cough and cold products may be harmful to children if they take more than the recommended dose.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: 非处方咳嗽和感冒产品可能对儿童有害，除非他们服用的剂量超过推荐剂量。
back: Over-the-counter cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they take more than the recommended dose.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: 如果您患有肝病，请在使用前咨询您的医疗保健专业人员。
back: If you have liver disease, consult your healthcare professional before use.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: 除非您患有肝病，否则请在使用前咨询您的医疗保健专业人员。
back: Unless you have liver disease, consult your healthcare professional before use.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: 如果您因对乙酰氨基酚出现严重皮肤反应，请勿再次服用任何含有对乙酰氨基酚的产品。
back: If you have a severe skin reaction to acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: 除非您因对乙酰氨基酚出现严重的皮肤反应，否则请勿再次服用任何含有对乙酰氨基酚的产品。
back: Do not take any products containing acetaminophen again unless you have had a severe skin reaction to acetaminophen.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: 疾病预防控制中心建议对流感患者和严重流感并发症风险较高的人立即进行治疗。
back: The CDC recommends immediate treatment for people with the flu and those who are at higher risk for severe flu complications.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: 疾病预防控制中心建议对流感患者或严重流感并发症风险较高的人立即进行治疗。
back: The CDC recommends immediate treatment for people who have the flu or are at higher risk for severe flu complications.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: 吸入胰岛素仅适用于患有 1 型或 2 型糖尿病的成人。
back: Inhaled insulin is only suitable for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: 吸入胰岛素仅适用于患有 1 型或 2 型糖尿病的儿童。
back: Inhaled insulin is only suitable for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: 人工胰腺主要用于帮助 1 型糖尿病患者。
back: Artificial pancreas is primarily used to help people with type 1 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: 人工胰腺主要用于帮助2型糖尿病患者。
back: Artificial pancreas is mainly used to help patients with type 2 diabetes.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: 疾病预防控制中心推荐奥司他韦用于治疗从出生开始的儿童流感。
back: The CDC recommends oseltamivir for treating influenza in children starting at birth.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: CDC 推荐奥司他韦用于治疗 65 岁以上成人流感。
back: The CDC recommends oseltamivir for the treatment of influenza in adults over 65 years of age.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: 如果您吞咽药片有困难，请告诉药剂师。
back: If you have trouble swallowing tablets, tell your pharmacist.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: 如果您吞咽药片有困难，药剂师会告诉您。
back: Your pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing your tablets.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: 请您的药剂师解释您不理解的处方标签上的任何术语或缩写。
back: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription labels that you don't understand.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: 您的药剂师会要求您解释处方标签上他们不理解的任何术语或缩写。
back: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on prescription labels that they do not understand.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: 医疗保健专业人员应该对您进行评估，以确定您是否正在经历严重的皮肤反应。
back: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: 您应该评估自己，以确定您是否正在经历严重的皮肤反应。
back: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a severe skin reaction.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: 告知您的医疗保健专业人员您服用的所有药物、维生素和补充剂。
back: Tell your health care professional about all the medicines, vitamins, and supplements you take.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: 您的医疗保健专业人员将告知您您服用的所有药物、维生素和补充剂。
back: Your healthcare professional will tell you about all the medications, vitamins, and supplements you take.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: 如果您不确定如何测量剂量，请联系您孩子的医疗保健专业人员。
back: If you are not sure how to measure your dose, contact your child's healthcare professional.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: 如果您孩子的医疗保健专业人员不确定如何测量剂量，他们会与您联系。
back: Your child's healthcare professional will contact you if they are unsure about how to measure the dose.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: 不建议巴洛沙韦用于治疗住院患者的流感。
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for the treatment of influenza in hospitalized patients.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: 不推荐巴洛沙韦用于治疗门诊患者的流感。
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for the treatment of influenza in outpatients.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: 请勿服用为他人开具的药物。
back: Do not take medications prescribed for others.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: 不要服用为您开的药物。
back: Do not take medications prescribed for you.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: 收到债务验证信息后，您有 30 天的时间以书面形式对债务提出异议。
back: Once you receive the debt verification information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: 收到债务验证信息后，您有 60 天的时间以书面形式对债务提出异议。
back: Once you receive the debt verification information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: 此信息将在收债人首次与您联系后五天内以书面通知的形式提供。
back: This information will be provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector first contacting you.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: 此信息将在收债人首次与您联系后十五天内以书面通知的形式提供。
back: This information will be provided in the form of a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector first contacting you.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: 请在发生更改的当月结束后 10 天内报告任何可能影响您的 SSI 的更改。
back: Please report any changes that may affect your SSI within 10 days of the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: 请在发生更改的当月结束后 30 天内报告任何可能影响您的 SSI 的更改。
back: Please report any changes that may affect your SSI within 30 days of the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: 每次您未能报告变更，我们可能会处以罚款，将您的 SSI 付款减少 25 至 100 美元。
back: Each time you fail to report a change, we may impose a penalty that reduces your SSI payment by $25 to $100.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: 每次您未能报告变更，我们可能会处以罚款，将您的 SSI 付款减少 250 美元至 1,000 美元。
back: Each time you fail to report a change, we may impose a penalty that reduces your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000.

en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 6 months.
bad_en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 3 months.
translation: 第一个制裁期是扣留付款 6 个月。
back: The first sanction period is the withholding of payments for 6 months.

en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 6 months.
bad_en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 3 months.
translation: 第一个制裁期是扣留付款 3 个月。
back: The first sanction period is withholding of payments for 3 months.

en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next six months.
bad_en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next twelve months.
translation: 如果绿卡已过期或将在未来六个月内过期，您必须更换绿卡。
back: If your green card has expired or will expire within the next six months, you must replace your green card.

en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next six months.
bad_en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next twelve months.
translation: 如果绿卡已过期或将在未来十二个月内过期，您必须更换绿卡。
back: If your green card has expired or will expire within the next twelve months, you must replace your green card.

en: Please wait 72 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
bad_en: Please wait 12 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
translation: 请在提交 I-90 表格后等待 72 小时以检查您的案件状态。
back: Please wait 72 hours after filing Form I-90 to check the status of your case.

en: Please wait 72 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
bad_en: Please wait 12 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
translation: 请在提交 I-90 表格后等待 12 小时以检查您的案件状态。
back: Please wait 12 hours after filing Form I-90 to check the status of your case.

en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 300 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
bad_en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 400 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
translation: 如果州或地方机构执行禁止同样歧视的法律，则 180 个日历日的提交截止日期将延长至 300 个日历日。
back: If a state or local agency enforces a law prohibiting the same discrimination, the 180 calendar day filing deadline will be extended to 300 calendar days.

en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 300 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
bad_en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 400 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
translation: 如果州或地方机构执行禁止同样歧视的法律，则 180 个日历日的提交截止日期将延长至 400 个日历日。
back: If a state or local agency enforces a law prohibiting the same discrimination, the 180 calendar day filing deadline will be extended to 400 calendar days.

en: The Cooling-Off Rule gives you three days to cancel certain sales made at your home, workplace, or dormitory.
bad_en: The Cooling-Off Rule gives you ten days to cancel certain sales made at your home, workplace, or dormitory.
translation: 冷静期规则允许您在三天内取消在家里、工作场所或宿舍进行的某些销售。
back: Cooling-off period rules allow you three days to cancel certain sales made at your home, workplace or dormitory.

en: The Cooling-Off Rule gives you three days to cancel certain sales made at your home, workplace, or dormitory.
bad_en: The Cooling-Off Rule gives you ten days to cancel certain sales made at your home, workplace, or dormitory.

back: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medication schedule before leaving.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: عندما تسافر، اسأل طبيبك أو الصيدلي عن التغييرات في جدول الأدوية الخاص بك بعد عودتك.
back: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medication schedule after you return.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: إذا كنت تعتقد أنك تناولت الكثير من عقار الاسيتامينوفين، فاطلب المساعدة الطبية على الفور.
back: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, seek medical help right away.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: إذا كنت تعتقد أنك تناولت كمية قليلة جدًا من عقار الأسيتامينوفين، فاطلب المساعدة الطبية على الفور.
back: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, seek medical help right away.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: لا تتناول أكثر من 6 كبسولات خلال 24 ساعة، ما لم يوجهك الطبيب.
back: Do not take more than 6 capsules in 24 hours, unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: لا تتناول أكثر من 6 كبسولات خلال 24 ساعة، حتى لو كان ذلك بتوجيه من الطبيب.
back: Do not take more than 6 capsules in 24 hours, even if directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: لا تستخدمه لأكثر من 10 أيام لعلاج الألم ما لم يوجهك الطبيب.
back: Do not use it for more than 10 days to treat pain unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: لا تستخدمه لأكثر من 10 أيام لعلاج الألم إذا وصفه الطبيب.
back: Do not use it for more than 10 days to treat pain if prescribed by your doctor.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: في حالة الحمل أو الرضاعة الطبيعية، اسأل أخصائي الصحة قبل الاستخدام.
back: If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: ما لم تكن حاملاً أو مرضعة، استشيري أخصائي الصحة قبل الاستخدام.
back: Unless pregnant or nursing, consult a health professional before use.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: يمكن أن تحدث تفاعلات جلدية خطيرة حتى لو كنت قد تناولت عقار الاسيتامينوفين في الماضي دون أي مشاكل.
back: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: يمكن أن تحدث تفاعلات جلدية خطيرة فقط إذا لم تتناول الأسيتامينوفين من قبل.
back: Serious skin reactions can only occur if you have never taken acetaminophen before.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: إذا أصبت بأي طفح جلدي أثناء استخدام دواء يحتوي على الأسيتامينوفين، توقف عن تناول الدواء واطلب الرعاية الطبية على الفور.
back: If you develop any rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop taking the medication and seek medical care immediately.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: ما لم تصاب بطفح جلدي أثناء استخدام دواء يحتوي على الأسيتامينوفين، توقف عن تناول الدواء واطلب الرعاية الطبية على الفور.
back: Unless you develop a rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop taking the medication and seek medical care right away.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: لا تغسل أي دواء إلا إذا كان مدرجًا في قائمة التنظيف.
back: Do not flush any medication unless it is listed on the flushing list.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: لا تغسل أي دواء إذا كان مدرجًا في قائمة التنظيف.
back: Do not flush any medication if it is on the flushing list.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: يمكن أن تكون منتجات السعال والبرد غير الموصوفة طبيًا ضارة للأطفال إذا تناولوا أكثر من الجرعة الموصى بها.
back: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they take more than the recommended dose.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: يمكن أن تكون منتجات السعال والبرد غير الموصوفة طبيًا ضارة للأطفال ما لم يحصلوا على أكثر من الجرعة الموصى بها.
back: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: اسأل أخصائي الرعاية الصحية الخاص بك قبل الاستخدام إذا كنت تعاني من مرض الكبد.
back: Ask your healthcare professional before use if you have liver disease.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: اسأل أخصائي الرعاية الصحية الخاص بك قبل الاستخدام إلا إذا كنت تعاني من مرض الكبد.
back: Ask your healthcare professional before use unless you have liver disease.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: إذا كان لديك رد فعل جلدي خطير مع عقار الاسيتامينوفين، فلا تتناول أي منتجات تحتوي على عقار الاسيتامينوفين مرة أخرى.
back: If you have a serious skin reaction to acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: ما لم تكن تعاني من رد فعل جلدي خطير مع عقار الاسيتامينوفين، فلا تتناول أي منتجات تحتوي على عقار الاسيتامينوفين مرة أخرى.
back: Unless you have a serious skin reaction to acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: يوصي مركز السيطرة على الأمراض (CDC) بالعلاج الفوري للأشخاص المصابين بالأنفلونزا والذين هم أكثر عرضة لخطر الإصابة بمضاعفات الأنفلونزا الخطيرة.
back: The CDC recommends immediate treatment for people with influenza who are at higher risk of developing serious influenza complications.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: يوصي مركز السيطرة على الأمراض (CDC) بالعلاج الفوري للأشخاص المصابين بالأنفلونزا أو الذين هم أكثر عرضة لخطر الإصابة بمضاعفات الأنفلونزا الخطيرة.
back: The CDC recommends immediate treatment for people who have influenza or who are at higher risk of developing serious influenza complications.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: الأنسولين المستنشق مخصص فقط للبالغين المصابين بداء السكري من النوع 1 أو النوع 2.
back: Inhaled insulin is only intended for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: الأنسولين المستنشق مخصص فقط للأطفال المصابين بداء السكري من النوع 1 أو النوع 2.
back: Inhaled insulin is only intended for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: يستخدم البنكرياس الاصطناعي بشكل أساسي لمساعدة الأشخاص المصابين بداء السكري من النوع الأول.
back: The artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: يُستخدم البنكرياس الاصطناعي بشكل أساسي لمساعدة الأشخاص المصابين بداء السكري من النوع الثاني.
back: The artificial pancreas is primarily used to help people with type 2 diabetes.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: يوصى مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها (CDC) باستخدام أوسيلتاميفير لعلاج الأنفلونزا لدى الأطفال بدءًا من الولادة.
back: The Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends that oseltamivir be used to treat influenza in children starting at birth.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: يوصى مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها (CDC) باستخدام أوسيلتاميفير لعلاج الأنفلونزا لدى البالغين بدءًا من سن 65 عامًا.
back: The Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends that oseltamivir be used to treat influenza in adults starting at age 65 years.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: أخبر الصيدلي إذا كنت تواجه صعوبة في بلع الحبوب.
back: Tell your pharmacist if you have difficulty swallowing pills.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: سيخبرك الصيدلي إذا كنت تواجه صعوبة في بلع الحبوب.
back: Your pharmacist will tell you if you have difficulty swallowing the pills.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: اطلب من الصيدلي أن يشرح لك أي مصطلحات أو اختصارات لا تفهمها على ملصق الوصفة الطبية الخاص بك.
back: Ask your pharmacist to explain to you any terms or abbreviations you do not understand on your prescription label.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: سيطلب منك الصيدلي شرح أي مصطلحات أو اختصارات موجودة على ملصق الوصفة الطبية الخاصة بك والتي لا يفهمها.
back: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that he or she does not understand.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: يجب أن يقوم أخصائي الرعاية الصحية بتقييمك لتحديد ما إذا كنت تعاني من رد فعل جلدي خطير.
back: You should be evaluated by a health care professional to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: يجب عليك تقييم نفسك لتحديد ما إذا كنت تعاني من رد فعل جلدي خطير.
back: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: أخبر أخصائي الرعاية الصحية الخاص بك بجميع الأدوية والفيتامينات والمكملات الغذائية التي تتناولها.
back: Tell your health care professional about all medications, vitamins, and nutritional supplements you take.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: سيخبرك أخصائي الرعاية الصحية الخاص بك بجميع الأدوية والفيتامينات والمكملات الغذائية التي تتناولها.
back: Your healthcare professional will tell you about all the medications, vitamins and nutritional supplements you take.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: اتصل بأخصائي الرعاية الصحية لطفلك إذا لم تكن متأكدًا من كيفية قياس الجرعة.
back: Contact your child's health care professional if you are not sure how to measure the dose.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: سيتصل بك أخصائي الرعاية الصحية لطفلك إذا لم يكن متأكدًا من كيفية قياس الجرعة.
back: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are not sure how to measure the dose.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: لا ينصح باللوكسافير لعلاج الانفلونزا لدى المرضى في المستشفى.
back: Loxavir is not recommended for treating influenza in hospitalized patients.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: لا ينصح باللوكسافير لعلاج الانفلونزا في العيادات الخارجية.
back: Loxavir is not recommended for outpatient treatment of influenza.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: لا تتناول الأدوية الموصوفة لشخص آخر.
back: Do not take medications prescribed for someone else.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: لا تتناول الأدوية الموصوفة لك.
back: Do not take prescribed medications.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: بمجرد حصولك على معلومات التحقق من صحة الدين، يكون لديك 30 يومًا للاعتراض على الدين كتابيًا.
back: Once you have the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: بمجرد حصولك على معلومات التحقق من صحة الدين، يكون لديك 60 يومًا للاعتراض على الدين كتابيًا.
back: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: يتم تقديم هذه المعلومات في إشعار كتابي خلال خمسة أيام من أول اتصال لجهة تحصيل الديون معك.
back: This information is provided in written notice within five days of the debt collector's first contact with you.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: يتم تقديم هذه المعلومات في إشعار كتابي خلال خمسة عشر يومًا من أول اتصال لجهة تحصيل الديون معك.
back: This information is provided in written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first contact with you.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: قم بالإبلاغ عن أي تغييرات قد تؤثر على SSI الخاص بك في موعد لا يتجاوز 10 أيام بعد نهاية الشهر الذي حدث فيه التغيير.
back: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: قم بالإبلاغ عن أي تغييرات قد تؤثر على SSI الخاص بك في موعد لا يتجاوز 30 يومًا بعد نهاية الشهر الذي حدث فيه التغيير.
back: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: قد نقوم بتطبيق عقوبة من شأنها تقليل دفعات SSI بمقدار 25 دولارًا إلى 100 دولار في كل مرة تفشل فيها في الإبلاغ عن التغيير.
back: We may implement a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 each time you fail to report the change.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: قد نقوم بتطبيق عقوبة من شأنها تقليل دفعات SSI بمقدار 250 دولارًا إلى 1000 دولار في كل مرة تفشل فيها في الإبلاغ عن التغيير.
back: We may implement a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 each time you fail to report the change.

en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 6 months.
bad_en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 3 months.
translation: فترة العقوبة الأولى هي حجب المدفوعات لمدة 6 أشهر.
back: The first penalty period is withholding payments for 6 months.

en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 6 months.
bad_en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 3 months.
translation: فترة العقوبة الأولى هي حجب المدفوعات لمدة 3 أشهر.
back: The first penalty period is withholding payments for 3 months.

en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next six months.
bad_en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next twelve months.
translation: يجب عليك استبدال البطاقة الخضراء الخاصة بك إذا انتهت صلاحيتها أو ستنتهي خلال الأشهر الستة المقبلة.
back: You must replace your green card if it has expired or will expire within the next six months.

en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next six months.
bad_en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next twelve months.
translation: يجب عليك استبدال البطاقة الخضراء الخاصة بك إذا انتهت صلاحيتها أو ستنتهي خلال الاثني عشر شهرًا القادمة.
back: You must replace your green card if it has expired or will expire within the next 12 months.

en: Please wait 72 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
bad_en: Please wait 12 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
translation: يرجى الانتظار لمدة 72 ساعة بعد تقديم النموذج I-90 الخاص بك للتحقق من حالة قضيتك.
back: Please allow 72 hours after submitting your Form I-90 to check the status of your case.

en: Please wait 72 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
bad_en: Please wait 12 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
translation: يرجى الانتظار لمدة 12 ساعة بعد تقديم النموذج I-90 الخاص بك للتحقق من حالة قضيتك.
back: Please wait 12 hours after submitting your Form I-90 to check the status of your case.

en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 300 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
bad_en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 400 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
translation: يتم تمديد الموعد النهائي لتقديم الطلبات وهو 180 يومًا تقويميًا إلى 300 يومًا تقويميًا إذا قامت إحدى الوكالات الحكومية أو المحلية بفرض قانون يحظر نفس التمييز.
back: The 180 calendar day filing deadline is extended to 300 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law prohibiting the same discrimination.

en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 300 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
bad_en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 400 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
translation: يتم تمديد الموعد النهائي لتقديم الطلبات وهو 180 يومًا تقويميًا إلى 400 يومًا تقويميًا إذا قامت إحدى الوكالات الحكومية أو المحلية بفرض قانون يحظر نفس التمييز.
back: The 180 calendar day filing deadline is extended to 400 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law prohibiting the same discrimination.

en: The Cooling-Off Rule gives you three days to cancel certain sales made at your home, workplace, or dormitory.
bad_en: The Cooling-Off Rule gives you ten days to cancel certain sales made at your home, workplace, or dormitory.
