en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 2 months and older.
translation: 6 महीने और उससे अधिक उम्र के लोगों में फ्लू के शुरुआती इलाज के लिए पेरामिविर को मंजूरी दी गई है।
back: Peramivir is approved for the initial treatment of flu in people 6 months of age and older.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 2 months and older.
translation: 2 महीने और उससे अधिक उम्र के लोगों में फ्लू के शुरुआती इलाज के लिए पेरामिविर को मंजूरी दी गई है।
back: Peramivir is approved for the initial treatment of flu in people 2 months of age and older.

en: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated flu in people 5 years and older.
bad_en: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated flu in people 2 years and older.
translation: 5 वर्ष और उससे अधिक उम्र के लोगों में सरल फ्लू के शुरुआती उपचार के लिए बालोक्सविर को मंजूरी दी गई है।
back: Baloxvir is approved for the initial treatment of simple flu in people ages 5 and older.

en: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated flu in people 5 years and older.
bad_en: Baloxavir is approved for early treatment of uncomplicated flu in people 2 years and older.
translation: बालोक्सविर को 2 वर्ष और उससे अधिक उम्र के लोगों में सरल फ्लू के शुरुआती उपचार के लिए अनुमोदित किया गया है।
back: Baloxvir is approved for the initial treatment of simple flu in people ages 2 years and older.

en: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 2 to 4 shots a day to reach their blood glucose targets.
bad_en: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 6 to 8 shots a day to reach their blood glucose targets.
translation: मधुमेह से पीड़ित कुछ लोग जो इंसुलिन लेते हैं उन्हें अपने रक्त शर्करा के लक्ष्य तक पहुंचने के लिए दिन में 2 से 4 शॉट्स की आवश्यकता होती है।
back: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 2 to 4 shots a day to reach their blood sugar goals.

en: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 2 to 4 shots a day to reach their blood glucose targets.
bad_en: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 6 to 8 shots a day to reach their blood glucose targets.
translation: मधुमेह से पीड़ित कुछ लोग जो इंसुलिन लेते हैं उन्हें अपने रक्त शर्करा के लक्ष्य तक पहुंचने के लिए प्रतिदिन 6 से 8 शॉट्स की आवश्यकता होती है।
back: Some people with diabetes who take insulin need 6 to 8 shots daily to reach their blood sugar goals.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 102.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
translation: यदि 2 महीने या उससे कम उम्र के शिशु को 100.4 डिग्री फ़ारेनहाइट या इससे अधिक बुखार हो तो डॉक्टर को बुलाएँ।
back: Call the doctor if an infant 2 months of age or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 102.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
translation: यदि 2 महीने या उससे कम उम्र के शिशु को 102.4 डिग्री फ़ारेनहाइट या इससे अधिक बुखार हो तो डॉक्टर को बुलाएँ।
back: Call the doctor if an infant 2 months of age or younger has a fever of 102.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 1.
translation: एफडीए 2 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों में खांसी और सर्दी के लक्षणों के लिए ओवर-द-काउंटर दवाओं की सिफारिश नहीं करता है।
back: The FDA does not recommend over-the-counter medications for cough and cold symptoms in children under 2 years of age.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter medicines for cough and cold symptoms in children younger than 1.
translation: एफडीए 1 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों में खांसी और सर्दी के लक्षणों के लिए ओवर-द-काउंटर दवाओं की सिफारिश नहीं करता है।
back: The FDA does not recommend over-the-counter medications for cough and cold symptoms in children under 1 year of age.

en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms last.
bad_en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 2 hours while symptoms last.
translation: वयस्क और 12 वर्ष और उससे अधिक उम्र के बच्चे: लक्षण रहने तक हर 6 घंटे में 2 गोलियां लें।
back: Adults and children 12 years and older: Take 2 tablets every 6 hours as long as symptoms last.

en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms last.
bad_en: Adults and children 12 years and over: take 2 caplets every 2 hours while symptoms last.
translation: वयस्क और 12 वर्ष और उससे अधिक उम्र के बच्चे: लक्षण रहने तक हर 2 घंटे में 2 गोलियां लें।
back: Adults and children 12 years of age and older: Take 2 tablets every 2 hours as long as symptoms last.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 10 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
translation: जब तक डॉक्टर द्वारा निर्देशित न किया जाए, 24 घंटे में 6 से अधिक कैपलेट्स न लें।
back: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 10 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
translation: जब तक डॉक्टर द्वारा निर्देशित न किया जाए, 24 घंटे में 10 से अधिक कैपलेट्स न लें।
back: Do not take more than 10 caplets in 24 hours unless directed by your doctor.

en: The maximum amount of acetaminophen in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The maximum amount of acetaminophen in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 g for adults.
translation: वयस्कों के लिए 24 घंटे में एसिटामिनोफेन की अधिकतम मात्रा 4,000 मिलीग्राम से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए।
back: The maximum amount of acetaminophen should not exceed 4,000 mg in 24 hours for adults.

en: The maximum amount of acetaminophen in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The maximum amount of acetaminophen in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 g for adults.
translation: वयस्कों के लिए 24 घंटे में एसिटामिनोफेन की अधिकतम मात्रा 4,000 ग्राम से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए।
back: The maximum amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours for adults should not exceed 4,000 grams.

en: Flu antiviral drugs are usually taken for five days.
bad_en: Flu antiviral drugs are usually taken for five weeks.
translation: फ़्लू एंटीवायरल दवाएं आमतौर पर पांच दिनों तक ली जाती हैं।
back: Flu antiviral medicines are usually taken for five days.

en: Flu antiviral drugs are usually taken for five days.
bad_en: Flu antiviral drugs are usually taken for five weeks.
translation: फ़्लू एंटीवायरल दवाएं आमतौर पर पांच सप्ताह तक ली जाती हैं।
back: Flu antiviral medications are usually taken for five weeks.

en: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 days after flu symptoms begin.
bad_en: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 weeks after flu symptoms begin.
translation: फ्लू के लक्षण शुरू होने के 1 से 2 दिन के भीतर शुरू करने पर एंटीवायरल दवाएं सबसे अच्छा काम करती हैं।
back: Antiviral medications work best when started within 1 to 2 days after flu symptoms begin.

en: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 days after flu symptoms begin.
bad_en: Antiviral drugs work best when started within 1 to 2 weeks after flu symptoms begin.
translation: फ्लू के लक्षण शुरू होने के 1 से 2 सप्ताह के भीतर शुरू करने पर एंटीवायरल दवाएं सबसे अच्छा काम करती हैं।
back: Antiviral medications work best when started within 1 to 2 weeks after flu symptoms begin.

en: Premixed insulin starts to work in 15 to 60 minutes and can last from 10 to 16 hours.
bad_en: Premixed insulin starts to work in 15 to 60 hours and can last from 10 to 16 hours.
translation: प्रीमिक्स्ड इंसुलिन 15 से 60 मिनट में काम करना शुरू कर देता है और 10 से 16 घंटे तक रह सकता है।
back: Premixed insulin starts working in 15 to 60 minutes and can last for 10 to 16 hours.

en: Premixed insulin starts to work in 15 to 60 minutes and can last from 10 to 16 hours.
bad_en: Premixed insulin starts to work in 15 to 60 hours and can last from 10 to 16 hours.
translation: प्रीमिक्स्ड इंसुलिन 15 से 60 घंटों में काम करना शुरू कर देता है और 10 से 16 घंटों तक रह सकता है।
back: Premixed insulin starts working in 15 to 60 hours and can last for 10 to 16 hours.

en: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each week can help you manage your blood glucose level.
bad_en: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each day can help you manage your blood glucose level.
translation: गर्भावधि मधुमेह के साथ, प्रत्येक सप्ताह 150 मिनट तक तेज चलना आपके रक्त शर्करा के स्तर को प्रबंधित करने में मदद कर सकता है।
back: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each week can help manage your blood sugar levels.

en: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each week can help you manage your blood glucose level.
bad_en: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes each day can help you manage your blood glucose level.
translation: गर्भकालीन मधुमेह के साथ, हर दिन 150 मिनट तक तेज चलना आपके रक्त शर्करा के स्तर को प्रबंधित करने में मदद कर सकता है।
back: With gestational diabetes, brisk walking for 150 minutes every day can help manage your blood sugar levels.

en: The plastic tube of an insulin pump stays inserted for several days.
bad_en: The plastic tube of an insulin pump stays inserted for several hours.
translation: इंसुलिन पंप की प्लास्टिक ट्यूब कई दिनों तक डाली रहती है।
back: The plastic tube of the insulin pump remains inserted for several days.

en: The plastic tube of an insulin pump stays inserted for several days.
bad_en: The plastic tube of an insulin pump stays inserted for several hours.
translation: इंसुलिन पंप की प्लास्टिक ट्यूब कई घंटों तक डाली रहती है।
back: The plastic tube of the insulin pump remains inserted for several hours.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 weeks for pain unless directed by a doctor.
translation: जब तक डॉक्टर द्वारा निर्देशित न किया जाए, दर्द के लिए 10 दिनों से अधिक समय तक उपयोग न करें।
back: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 weeks for pain unless directed by a doctor.
translation: जब तक डॉक्टर द्वारा निर्देशित न किया जाए, दर्द के लिए 10 सप्ताह से अधिक समय तक उपयोग न करें।
back: Do not use for more than 10 weeks for pain unless directed by a doctor.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 weeks.
translation: यदि बुखार बदतर हो जाता है या 3 दिनों से अधिक समय तक रहता है तो उपयोग बंद कर दें और डॉक्टर से पूछें।
back: Stop use if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days and ask a doctor.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 weeks.
translation: यदि बुखार बदतर हो जाता है या 3 सप्ताह से अधिक समय तक रहता है तो उपयोग बंद कर दें और डॉक्टर से पूछें।
back: Stop use if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 weeks and ask a doctor.

en: Call a doctor if an infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Celsius or higher.
translation: यदि शिशु को 100.4 डिग्री फ़ारेनहाइट या इससे अधिक बुखार हो तो डॉक्टर को बुलाएँ।
back: Call the doctor if your baby has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.

en: Call a doctor if an infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant has a fever of 100.4 degrees Celsius or higher.
translation: यदि शिशु को 100.4 डिग्री सेल्सियस या इससे अधिक बुखार हो तो डॉक्टर को बुलाएँ।
back: Call the doctor if your baby has a fever of 100.4 degrees Celsius or higher.

en: Taking medicines on an empty stomach generally means taking your pills at least two hours before you eat.
bad_en: Taking medicines on an empty stomach generally means taking your pills at least two minutes before you eat.
translation: खाली पेट दवाएँ लेने का मतलब आम तौर पर खाने से कम से कम दो घंटे पहले अपनी गोलियाँ लेना होता है।
back: Taking medications on an empty stomach usually means taking your pills at least two hours before eating.

en: Taking medicines on an empty stomach generally means taking your pills at least two hours before you eat.
bad_en: Taking medicines on an empty stomach generally means taking your pills at least two minutes before you eat.
translation: खाली पेट दवाएँ लेने का मतलब आम तौर पर खाने से कम से कम दो मिनट पहले अपनी गोलियाँ लेना होता है।
back: Taking medications on an empty stomach usually means taking your pills at least two minutes before eating.

en: Do not use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.
bad_en: Use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.
translation: एक समय में एक से अधिक एसिटामिनोफेन युक्त उत्पाद का उपयोग न करें।
back: Do not use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.

en: Do not use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.
bad_en: Use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.
translation: एक समय में एक से अधिक एसिटामिनोफेन युक्त उत्पाद का उपयोग करें।
back: Use more than one acetaminophen-containing product at a time.

en: Never take more acetaminophen than what the label says, even if you still have fever or pain.
bad_en: Take more acetaminophen than what the label says if you still have fever or pain.
translation: लेबल पर लिखी मात्रा से अधिक एसिटामिनोफेन कभी न लें, भले ही आपको अभी भी बुखार या दर्द हो।
back: Never take more acetaminophen than is written on the label, even if you still have fever or pain.

en: Never take more acetaminophen than what the label says, even if you still have fever or pain.
bad_en: Take more acetaminophen than what the label says if you still have fever or pain.
translation: यदि आपको अभी भी बुखार या दर्द है तो लेबल पर लिखी मात्रा से अधिक एसिटामिनोफेन लें।
back: If you still have fever or pain, take more acetaminophen than recommended on the label.

en: Do not use a product intended for adults if the child is less than 12 years of age.
bad_en: Use a product intended for adults if the child is less than 12 years of age.
translation: यदि बच्चा 12 वर्ष से कम उम्र का है तो वयस्कों के लिए बने उत्पाद का उपयोग न करें।
back: Do not use a product meant for adults if the child is under 12 years of age.

en: Do not use a product intended for adults if the child is less than 12 years of age.
bad_en: Use a product intended for adults if the child is less than 12 years of age.
translation: यदि बच्चा 12 वर्ष से कम उम्र का है तो वयस्कों के लिए बने उत्पाद का उपयोग करें।
back: If the child is under 12 years of age, use a product made for adults.

en: If giving liquid acetaminophen, do not use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device from a different product.
bad_en: If giving liquid acetaminophen, use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device from a different product.
translation: यदि तरल एसिटामिनोफेन दे रहे हैं, तो रसोई के चम्मच या किसी भिन्न उत्पाद से बने खुराक उपकरण का उपयोग न करें।
back: If giving liquid acetaminophen, do not use a kitchen spoon or dosing device made from a different product.

en: If giving liquid acetaminophen, do not use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device from a different product.
bad_en: If giving liquid acetaminophen, use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device from a different product.
translation: यदि तरल एसिटामिनोफेन दे रहे हैं, तो रसोई के चम्मच या किसी भिन्न उत्पाद से बने खुराक उपकरण का उपयोग करें।
back: If giving liquid acetaminophen, use a kitchen spoon or a dosing device made from a different product.

en: Do not stop taking any prescribed drugs without first talking to your health care professional.
bad_en: Stop taking any prescribed drugs without first talking to your health care professional.
translation: अपने स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर से बात किए बिना कोई भी निर्धारित दवा लेना बंद न करें।
back: Do not stop taking any prescribed medications without talking to your health care professional.

en: Do not stop taking any prescribed drugs without first talking to your health care professional.
bad_en: Stop taking any prescribed drugs without first talking to your health care professional.
translation: अपने स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर से बात किए बिना कोई भी निर्धारित दवा लेना बंद कर दें।
back: Stop taking any prescribed medications without talking to your health care professional.

en: When flying, carry your medicines with you; do not pack them in your checked luggage.
bad_en: When flying, do not carry your medicines with you; pack them in your checked luggage.
translation: उड़ान भरते समय अपनी दवाएँ अपने साथ रखें; उन्हें अपने चेक किए गए सामान में पैक न करें।
back: Keep your medicines with you when you fly; Don't pack them in your checked luggage.

en: When flying, carry your medicines with you; do not pack them in your checked luggage.
bad_en: When flying, do not carry your medicines with you; pack them in your checked luggage.
translation: उड़ान भरते समय अपनी दवाएँ अपने साथ न रखें; उन्हें अपने चेक किए गए सामान में पैक करें।
back: Do not take your medicines with you when flying; Pack them in your checked luggage.

en: Do not chew, break, or crush tablets without first asking if this will change the way the drug works.
bad_en: Chew, break, or crush tablets without first asking if this will change the way the drug works.
translation: पहले यह पूछे बिना कि क्या इससे दवा के काम करने का तरीका बदल जाएगा, गोलियों को चबाएं, तोड़े या कुचलें नहीं।
back: Do not chew, break or crush the tablets without asking first whether this will change the way the medicine works.

en: Do not chew, break, or crush tablets without first asking if this will change the way the drug works.
bad_en: Chew, break, or crush tablets without first asking if this will change the way the drug works.
translation: पहले यह पूछे बिना कि क्या इससे दवा के काम करने का तरीका बदल जाएगा, गोलियाँ चबाएँ, तोड़ें या कुचल दें।
back: Do not chew, break or crush the tablets without asking first whether this will change the way the medicine works.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
bad_en: Baloxavir is recommended for treatment of flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
translation: गर्भावस्था के दौरान या स्तनपान के दौरान फ्लू के इलाज के लिए बालोक्साविर की सिफारिश नहीं की जाती है।
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for treating flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
bad_en: Baloxavir is recommended for treatment of flu during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
translation: गर्भावस्था के दौरान या स्तनपान के दौरान फ्लू के इलाज के लिए बालोक्साविर की सिफारिश की जाती है।
back: Baloxavir is recommended for treating flu during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

en: Even if you are feeling better, you should not stop taking your prescription drug unless your doctor says it's okay.
bad_en: Even if you are not feeling better, you should stop taking your prescription drug unless your doctor says it's okay.
translation: भले ही आप बेहतर महसूस कर रहे हों, आपको अपनी डॉक्टर द्वारा बताई गई दवा तब तक लेना बंद नहीं करना चाहिए जब तक कि आपका डॉक्टर यह न कहे कि यह ठीक है।
back: Even if you feel better, you should not stop taking your prescribed medicine until your doctor says it is okay.

en: Even if you are feeling better, you should not stop taking your prescription drug unless your doctor says it's okay.
bad_en: Even if you are not feeling better, you should stop taking your prescription drug unless your doctor says it's okay.
translation: यहां तक ​​कि अगर आप बेहतर महसूस नहीं कर रहे हैं, तब भी आपको अपनी डॉक्टर द्वारा बताई गई दवा लेना बंद कर देना चाहिए जब तक कि आपका डॉक्टर यह न कहे कि यह ठीक है।
back: Even if you don't feel better, you should stop taking your prescribed medication until your doctor says it's okay.

en: Don't crush pills before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.
bad_en: Crush the pills before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.
translation: गोलियों को गंदगी, बिल्ली के कूड़े, या प्रयुक्त कॉफ़ी ग्राउंड के साथ मिलाने से पहले कुचलें नहीं।
back: Do not crush the tablets before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.

en: Don't crush pills before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.
bad_en: Crush the pills before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.
translation: गोलियों को गंदगी, बिल्ली के कूड़े, या इस्तेमाल की गई कॉफी के साथ मिलाने से पहले कुचल दें।
back: Crush the tablets before mixing them with dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds.

en: Flu antiviral drugs should ideally be started within two days after becoming sick.
bad_en: Flu antiviral drugs should ideally be started only after two days of being sick.
translation: आदर्श रूप से बीमार होने के दो दिन के भीतर फ्लू एंटीवायरल दवाएं शुरू कर देनी चाहिए।
back: Flu antiviral medications should ideally be started within two days of becoming ill.

en: Flu antiviral drugs should ideally be started within two days after becoming sick.
bad_en: Flu antiviral drugs should ideally be started only after two days of being sick.
translation: फ्लू की एंटीवायरल दवाएं आदर्श रूप से बीमार होने के दो दिन बाद ही शुरू की जानी चाहिए।
back: Flu antiviral medications should ideally be started two days after becoming ill.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional after use if you have liver disease.
translation: यदि आपको लीवर की बीमारी है तो उपयोग करने से पहले अपने स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर से पूछें।
back: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional after use if you have liver disease.
translation: उपयोग के बाद अपने स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर से पूछें कि क्या आपको लीवर की बीमारी है।
back: Ask your health care professional after use if you have liver disease.

en: Check the label on your medicine before leaving the pharmacy.
bad_en: Check the label on your medicine after leaving the pharmacy.
translation: फार्मेसी छोड़ने से पहले अपनी दवा पर लगे लेबल की जाँच करें।
back: Check the label on your medicine before leaving the pharmacy.

en: Check the label on your medicine before leaving the pharmacy.
bad_en: Check the label on your medicine after leaving the pharmacy.
translation: फार्मेसी छोड़ने के बाद अपनी दवा पर लगे लेबल की जाँच करें।
back: Check the label on your medicine after you leave the pharmacy.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children older than 2.
translation: एफडीए 2 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों के लिए ओवर-द-काउंटर खांसी और सर्दी की दवाओं की सिफारिश नहीं करता है।
back: The FDA does not recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children under 2 years of age.

en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children younger than 2.
bad_en: The FDA doesn't recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children older than 2.
translation: एफडीए 2 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र के बच्चों के लिए ओवर-द-काउंटर खांसी और सर्दी की दवाओं की सिफारिश नहीं करता है।
back: The FDA does not recommend over-the-counter cough and cold medicines for children older than 2 years.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
translation: यदि 2 महीने या उससे कम उम्र के शिशु को 100.4 डिग्री फ़ारेनहाइट या इससे अधिक बुखार हो तो डॉक्टर को बुलाएँ।
back: Call the doctor if an infant 2 months of age or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.

en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or higher.
bad_en: Call a doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
translation: यदि 2 महीने या उससे कम उम्र के शिशु को 100.4 डिग्री फ़ारेनहाइट या उससे कम बुखार हो तो डॉक्टर को बुलाएँ।
back: Call the doctor if an infant 2 months or younger has a fever of 100.4 degrees Fahrenheit or less.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and younger.
translation: 6 महीने और उससे अधिक उम्र के लोगों में फ्लू के शुरुआती इलाज के लिए पेरामिविर को मंजूरी दी गई है।
back: Peramivir is approved for the initial treatment of flu in people 6 months of age and older.

en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and older.
bad_en: Peramivir is approved for early treatment of flu in people 6 months and younger.
translation: 6 महीने और उससे कम उम्र के लोगों में फ्लू के शुरुआती इलाज के लिए पेरामिविर को मंजूरी दी गई है।
back: Peramivir is approved for the initial treatment of flu in people 6 months of age and younger.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days.
translation: यदि बुखार बदतर हो जाता है या 3 दिनों से अधिक समय तक रहता है तो उपयोग बंद कर दें और डॉक्टर से पूछें।
back: Stop use if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days and ask a doctor.

en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days.
bad_en: Stop use and ask a doctor if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days.
translation: यदि बुखार बदतर हो जाए या 3 दिन से कम समय तक रहे तो उपयोग बंद कर दें और डॉक्टर से पूछें।
back: Stop use if fever gets worse or lasts less than 3 days and ask a doctor.

en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.
translation: वयस्कों के लिए 24 घंटे में ली गई एसिटामिनोफेन की कुल मात्रा 4,000 मिलीग्राम से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए।
back: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not exceed 4,000 mg for adults.

en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be more than 4,000 mg for adults.
bad_en: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.
translation: वयस्कों के लिए 24 घंटे में ली गई एसिटामिनोफेन की कुल मात्रा 4,000 मिलीग्राम से कम नहीं होनी चाहिए।
back: The total amount of acetaminophen taken in 24 hours should not be less than 4,000 mg for adults.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: जब आप यात्रा करें, तो प्रस्थान करने से पहले अपने डॉक्टर या फार्मासिस्ट से अपनी दवा के शेड्यूल में बदलाव के बारे में पूछें।
back: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medication schedule before departure.

en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule before you depart.
bad_en: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medicine schedule after you return.
translation: जब आप यात्रा करते हैं, तो लौटने के बाद अपने डॉक्टर या फार्मासिस्ट से अपनी दवा के शेड्यूल में बदलाव के बारे में पूछें।
back: When you travel, ask your doctor or pharmacist about changes to your medication schedule after you return.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: यदि आपको लगता है कि आपने बहुत अधिक एसिटामिनोफेन ले लिया है, तो तुरंत चिकित्सा सहायता लें।
back: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.

en: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
bad_en: If you think you have taken too little acetaminophen, get medical help right away.
translation: यदि आपको लगता है कि आपने बहुत कम एसिटामिनोफेन लिया है, तो तुरंत चिकित्सा सहायता लें।
back: If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, get medical help right away.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: जब तक डॉक्टर द्वारा निर्देशित न किया जाए, 24 घंटे में 6 से अधिक कैपलेट्स न लें।
back: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours unless directed by your doctor.

en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by a doctor.
translation: 24 घंटे में 6 से अधिक कैपलेट्स न लें, भले ही डॉक्टर ने निर्देश दिया हो।
back: Do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, even if directed by your doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: जब तक डॉक्टर द्वारा निर्देशित न किया जाए, दर्द के लिए 10 दिनों से अधिक समय तक उपयोग न करें।
back: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.

en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.
bad_en: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain if directed by a doctor.
translation: डॉक्टर द्वारा निर्देशित होने पर दर्द के लिए 10 दिनों से अधिक समय तक उपयोग न करें।
back: Do not use for more than 10 days for pain unless directed by a doctor.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: यदि गर्भवती हैं या स्तनपान करा रही हैं, तो उपयोग से पहले किसी स्वास्थ्य पेशेवर से पूछें।
back: If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use.

en: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
bad_en: Unless pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.
translation: जब तक आप गर्भवती न हों या स्तनपान न करा रही हों, उपयोग से पहले किसी स्वास्थ्य पेशेवर से पूछें।
back: Ask a health professional before use unless you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: यदि आपने पहले बिना किसी समस्या के एसिटामिनोफेन लिया हो तो भी त्वचा पर गंभीर प्रतिक्रियाएँ हो सकती हैं।
back: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen before without any problems.

en: Serious skin reactions can occur even if you have taken acetaminophen in the past without any problems.
bad_en: Serious skin reactions can occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.
translation: गंभीर त्वचा प्रतिक्रियाएं केवल तभी हो सकती हैं जब आपने पहले कभी एसिटामिनोफेन नहीं लिया हो।
back: Serious skin reactions may occur only if you have never taken acetaminophen before.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: यदि एसिटामिनोफेन युक्त दवा का उपयोग करते समय आपकी त्वचा पर कोई दाने विकसित होते हैं, तो दवा बंद कर दें और तुरंत चिकित्सा सहायता लें।
back: If you develop a skin rash while using a medicine containing acetaminophen, stop the medicine and get medical help right away.

en: If you develop any skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
bad_en: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medication containing acetaminophen, stop the medication and seek medical attention immediately.
translation: जब तक आप एसिटामिनोफेन युक्त दवा का उपयोग करते समय त्वचा पर चकत्ते विकसित नहीं करते हैं, तब तक दवा बंद कर दें और तुरंत चिकित्सा सहायता लें।
back: Unless you develop a skin rash while using a medicine containing acetaminophen, stop the medicine and get medical help right away.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: किसी भी दवा को तब तक फ्लश न करें जब तक वह फ्लश सूची में न हो।
back: Do not flush any medication unless it is on the flush list.

en: Don't flush any medicine unless it is on the Flush List.
bad_en: Don't flush any medicine if it is on the Flush List.
translation: यदि कोई दवा फ्लश सूची में है तो उसे फ्लश न करें।
back: If a medication is on the flush list, do not flush it.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: यदि बच्चों को अनुशंसित खुराक से अधिक मिल जाए तो गैर-पर्चे खांसी और सर्दी के उत्पाद उनके लिए हानिकारक हो सकते हैं।
back: Non-prescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.

en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children if they get more than the recommended dose.
bad_en: Nonprescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they get more than the recommended dose.
translation: बिना प्रिस्क्रिप्शन वाली खांसी और सर्दी के उत्पाद बच्चों के लिए हानिकारक हो सकते हैं, जब तक कि उन्हें अनुशंसित खुराक से अधिक न मिल जाए।
back: Non-prescription cough and cold products can be harmful to children unless they receive more than the recommended dose.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: यदि आपको लीवर की बीमारी है तो उपयोग करने से पहले अपने स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर से पूछें।
back: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.

en: Ask your health care professional before use if you have liver disease.
bad_en: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.
translation: जब तक आपको लीवर की बीमारी न हो, उपयोग करने से पहले अपने स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर से पूछें।
back: Ask your health care professional before use unless you have liver disease.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: यदि आपको एसिटामिनोफेन से त्वचा पर कोई गंभीर प्रतिक्रिया हुई है, तो एसिटामिनोफेन युक्त कोई भी उत्पाद दोबारा न लें।
back: If you have had a serious skin reaction to acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.

en: If you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
bad_en: Unless you have had a serious skin reaction with acetaminophen, do not take any products containing acetaminophen again.
translation: जब तक आपको एसिटामिनोफेन से त्वचा पर कोई गंभीर प्रतिक्रिया न हो, एसिटामिनोफेन युक्त कोई भी उत्पाद दोबारा न लें।
back: Unless you have a serious skin reaction to acetaminophen, do not take any product containing acetaminophen again.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: सीडीसी उन लोगों के लिए शीघ्र उपचार की सिफारिश करता है जिन्हें फ्लू है और जिन्हें फ्लू की गंभीर जटिलताओं का खतरा बढ़ जाता है।
back: The CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have the flu and are at increased risk for serious flu complications.

en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu and who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
bad_en: CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have flu or who are at increased risk of serious flu complications.
translation: सीडीसी उन लोगों के लिए शीघ्र उपचार की सिफारिश करता है जिन्हें फ्लू है या जिन्हें फ्लू की गंभीर जटिलताओं का खतरा बढ़ गया है।
back: The CDC recommends prompt treatment for people who have the flu or are at increased risk for serious flu complications.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: इनहेल्ड इंसुलिन केवल टाइप 1 या टाइप 2 मधुमेह वाले वयस्कों के लिए है।
back: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: Inhaled insulin is only for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
bad_en: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
translation: इनहेल्ड इंसुलिन केवल टाइप 1 या टाइप 2 मधुमेह वाले बच्चों के लिए है।
back: Inhaled insulin is only for children with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: कृत्रिम अग्न्याशय का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से टाइप 1 मधुमेह वाले लोगों की मदद के लिए किया जाता है।
back: Artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.

en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 1 diabetes.
bad_en: An artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.
translation: कृत्रिम अग्न्याशय का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से टाइप 2 मधुमेह वाले लोगों की मदद के लिए किया जाता है।
back: Artificial pancreas is mainly used to help people with type 2 diabetes.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: जन्म से ही बच्चों में फ्लू के इलाज के लिए सीडीसी द्वारा ओसेल्टामिविर की सिफारिश की जाती है।
back: Oseltamivir is recommended by the CDC for the treatment of flu in children from birth.

en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in children beginning from birth.
bad_en: Oseltamivir is recommended by CDC for treatment of flu in adults beginning from age 65.
translation: 65 वर्ष की आयु से शुरू होने वाले वयस्कों में फ्लू के इलाज के लिए सीडीसी द्वारा ओसेल्टामिविर की सिफारिश की जाती है।
back: Oseltamivir is recommended by the CDC for treating flu in adults starting at age 65.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: यदि आपको गोलियाँ निगलने में परेशानी हो तो फार्मासिस्ट को बताएं।
back: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing the tablets.

en: Tell the pharmacist if you have trouble swallowing pills.
bad_en: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing pills.
translation: यदि आपको गोलियां निगलने में परेशानी हो तो फार्मासिस्ट आपको बताएगा।
back: The pharmacist will tell you if you have trouble swallowing the tablets.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: अपने फार्मासिस्ट से अपने नुस्खे के लेबल पर किसी भी नियम या संक्षिप्ताक्षर को समझाने के लिए कहें जो आपको समझ में नहीं आता है।
back: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription labels that you do not understand.

en: Ask your pharmacist to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that you don't understand.
bad_en: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they don't understand.
translation: आपका फार्मासिस्ट आपसे आपके प्रिस्क्रिप्शन लेबल पर ऐसे किसी भी नियम या संक्षिप्ताक्षर को समझाने के लिए कहेगा जो उन्हें समझ में नहीं आता है।
back: Your pharmacist will ask you to explain any terms or abbreviations on your prescription label that they do not understand.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: एक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर को यह निर्धारित करने के लिए आपका मूल्यांकन करना चाहिए कि क्या आप किसी गंभीर त्वचा प्रतिक्रिया का अनुभव कर रहे हैं।
back: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing any serious skin reactions.

en: A health care professional should evaluate you to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
bad_en: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing a serious skin reaction.
translation: आपको यह निर्धारित करने के लिए स्वयं का मूल्यांकन करना चाहिए कि क्या आप किसी गंभीर त्वचा प्रतिक्रिया का अनुभव कर रहे हैं।
back: You should evaluate yourself to determine if you are experiencing any serious skin reactions.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
bad_en: Your health care professional will inform you of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.
translation: अपने स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर को आपके द्वारा ली जाने वाली सभी दवाओं, विटामिनों और पूरकों के बारे में सूचित करें।
back: Inform your health care professional about all medicines, vitamins and supplements you take.

en: Inform your health care professional of all drugs, vitamins, and supplements you take.

translation: आपका स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर आपको आपके द्वारा ली जाने वाली सभी दवाओं, विटामिन और पूरकों के बारे में सूचित करेगा।
back: Your health care professional will keep you informed about all the medications, vitamins, and supplements you take.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: यदि आप अनिश्चित हैं कि खुराक कैसे मापें तो अपने बच्चे के स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर से संपर्क करें।
back: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure the dose.

en: Contact your child's health care professional if you are unsure how to measure a dose.
bad_en: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure how to measure a dose.
translation: यदि आपके बच्चे के स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पेशेवर खुराक मापने के बारे में अनिश्चित हैं तो वे आपसे संपर्क करेंगे।
back: Your child's health care professional will contact you if they are unsure about measuring the dose.

en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.
bad_en: Baloxavir is not recommended for treatment of flu in outpatients.
translation: अस्पताल में भर्ती मरीजों में फ्लू के इलाज के लिए बालोक्साविर की सिफारिश नहीं की जाती है।
back: Baloxavir is not recommended for the treatment of flu in hospitalized patients.

translation: बाह्य रोगियों में फ्लू के इलाज के लिए बालोक्सविर की सिफारिश नहीं की जाती है।
back: Baloxvir is not recommended for the treatment of flu in outpatients.

en: Do not take medicines prescribed for another person.
bad_en: Do not take medicines prescribed for you.
translation: किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के लिए निर्धारित दवाएँ न लें।
back: Do not take medications prescribed for someone else.

translation: आपके लिए निर्धारित दवाएँ न लें।
back: Do not take medications prescribed for you.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: एक बार जब आप ऋण सत्यापन जानकारी प्राप्त कर लेते हैं, तो आपके पास ऋण पर लिखित रूप से विवाद करने के लिए 30 दिन का समय होता है।
back: Once you receive the loan verification information, you have 30 days to dispute the loan in writing.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 60 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: एक बार जब आप ऋण सत्यापन जानकारी प्राप्त कर लेते हैं, तो आपके पास ऋण पर लिखित रूप से विवाद करने के लिए 60 दिन का समय होता है।
back: Once you receive the loan verification information, you have 60 days to dispute the loan in writing.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: यह जानकारी ऋण संग्राहक द्वारा आपके साथ प्रथम संचार के पांच दिनों के भीतर एक लिखित नोटिस में प्रदान की जाती है।
back: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.

en: This information is provided in a written notice within five days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
bad_en: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector's first communication with you.
translation: यह जानकारी ऋण संग्राहक द्वारा आपके साथ पहली बार संचार करने के पंद्रह दिनों के भीतर एक लिखित नोटिस में प्रदान की जाती है।
back: This information is provided in a written notice within fifteen days of the debt collector first communicating with you.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: किसी भी परिवर्तन की रिपोर्ट करें जो आपके एसएसआई को प्रभावित कर सकता है, उस महीने के अंत के 10 दिनों के भीतर रिपोर्ट करें जिसमें परिवर्तन हुआ था।
back: Report any changes that may affect your SSI within 10 days of the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
bad_en: Report any changes that may affect your SSI no later than 30 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.
translation: किसी भी परिवर्तन की रिपोर्ट करें जो आपके एसएसआई को प्रभावित कर सकता है, उस महीने के अंत के 30 दिनों के भीतर रिपोर्ट करें जिसमें परिवर्तन हुआ था।
back: Report any changes that may affect your SSI within 30 days of the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: हर बार जब आप किसी बदलाव की रिपोर्ट करने में विफल रहते हैं तो हम जुर्माना लगा सकते हैं जिससे आपका एसएसआई भुगतान $25 से $100 तक कम हो जाएगा।
back: We may impose a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 each time you fail to report a change.

en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $25 to $100 for each time you fail to report a change.
bad_en: We may apply a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 for each time you fail to report a change.
translation: हर बार जब आप किसी बदलाव की रिपोर्ट करने में विफल रहते हैं तो हम जुर्माना लगा सकते हैं जिससे आपका एसएसआई भुगतान $250 से $1,000 तक कम हो जाएगा।
back: We may impose a penalty that will reduce your SSI payment by $250 to $1,000 each time you fail to report a change.

en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 6 months.
bad_en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 3 months.
translation: पहली मंजूरी अवधि 6 महीने के लिए भुगतान रोकना है।
back: The first sanction period is to stop payments for 6 months.

en: The first sanction period is a withholding of payments for 6 months.

back: The first sanction period is to stop payments for 3 months.

en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next six months.
bad_en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next twelve months.
translation: यदि आपका ग्रीन कार्ड समाप्त हो गया है या अगले छह महीनों के भीतर समाप्त हो जाएगा तो आपको उसे बदलना होगा।
back: If your green card has expired or will expire within the next six months, you will need to replace it.

en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next six months.
bad_en: You must replace your Green Card if it is expired or will expire within the next twelve months.
translation: यदि आपका ग्रीन कार्ड समाप्त हो गया है या अगले बारह महीनों के भीतर समाप्त हो जाएगा तो आपको उसे बदलना होगा।
back: If your green card has expired or will expire within the next twelve months you will need to replace it.

en: Please wait 72 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
bad_en: Please wait 12 hours after you filed your Form I-90 to check your case status.
translation: कृपया अपने मामले की स्थिति जांचने के लिए अपना फॉर्म I-90 दाखिल करने के 72 घंटे बाद प्रतीक्षा करें।

back: Please wait 12 hours after filing your Form I-90 to check the status of your case.

en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 300 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
bad_en: The 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 400 calendar days if a state or local agency enforces a law that prohibits the same discrimination.
translation: यदि कोई राज्य या स्थानीय एजेंसी समान भेदभाव को प्रतिबंधित करने वाला कानून लागू करती है, तो 180-कैलेंडर-दिन की फाइलिंग की समय सीमा 300 कैलेंडर दिनों तक बढ़ा दी जाती है।
back: If a state or local agency enacts a law prohibiting similar discrimination, the 180-calendar-day filing deadline is extended to 300 calendar days.

en: The Cooling-Off Rule gives you three days to cancel certain sales made at your home, workplace, or dormitory.

translation: कूलिंग-ऑफ नियम आपको अपने घर, कार्यस्थल या शयनगृह में की गई कुछ बिक्री को रद्द करने के लिए तीन दिन का समय देता है।

en: You may qualify to apply online for a long-term payment plan if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest.
bad_en: You may qualify to apply online for a long-term payment plan if you owe $500,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest.

back: If you owe $50,000 or less in combined taxes, penalties and interest, you may be eligible to apply online for a long-term payment plan.

translation: किसी भी परिवर्तन की रिपोर्ट उस माह की समाप्ति के 10 दिन से पहले न करें जिसमें परिवर्तन हुआ हो।
back: Any changes should be reported no later than 10 days after the end of the month in which the change occurred.

en: If your filing deadline is fast approaching, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.
bad_en: If your filing deadline has already passed, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.
translation: यदि आपकी फाइलिंग की समय सीमा तेजी से नजदीक आ रही है, तो तत्काल साक्षात्कार के लिए पूछने के लिए 1-800-669-4000 पर कॉल करें।
back: If your filing deadline is rapidly approaching, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.

en: If your filing deadline is fast approaching, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.
bad_en: If your filing deadline has already passed, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.
translation: यदि आपकी फाइलिंग की समय सीमा पहले ही बीत चुकी है, तो तत्काल साक्षात्कार के लिए पूछने के लिए 1-800-669-4000 पर कॉल करें।
back: If your filing deadline has already passed, call 1-800-669-4000 to ask for an immediate interview.

en: You must file a charge with the EEOC before you can file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination.
bad_en: You must file a charge with the EEOC after you file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination.
translation: गैरकानूनी भेदभाव के लिए मुकदमा दायर करने से पहले आपको ईईओसी के पास आरोप दायर करना होगा।
back: Before you can file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination, you must file a charge with the EEOC.

en: You must file a charge with the EEOC before you can file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination.
bad_en: You must file a charge with the EEOC after you file a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination.
translation: गैरकानूनी भेदभाव के लिए मुकदमा दायर करने के बाद आपको ईईओसी के पास आरोप दायर करना होगा।
back: After filing a lawsuit for unlawful discrimination, you must file charges with the EEOC.

en: Applicants should submit the form within 30 days from the date of their installment agreement acceptance letter.
bad_en: Applicants should submit the form at least 30 days after the date of their installment agreement acceptance letter.
translation: आवेदकों को अपने किस्त अनुबंध स्वीकृति पत्र की तारीख से 30 दिनों के भीतर फॉर्म जमा करना चाहिए।
back: Applicants should submit the form within 30 days from the date of their installment contract acceptance letter.

en: Applicants should submit the form within 30 days from the date of their installment agreement acceptance letter.
bad_en: Applicants should submit the form at least 30 days after the date of their installment agreement acceptance letter.
translation: आवेदकों को अपने किस्त अनुबंध स्वीकृति पत्र की तारीख के कम से कम 30 दिन बाद फॉर्म जमा करना चाहिए।
back: Applicants should submit the form at least 30 days after the date of their installment contract acceptance letter.

en: If you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged a user fee.
bad_en: Unless you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged a user fee.
translation: यदि आप अल्पकालिक भुगतान योजना के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त करते हैं, तो आपसे उपयोगकर्ता शुल्क नहीं लिया जाएगा।
back: If you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged user fees.

en: If you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged a user fee.
bad_en: Unless you qualify for a short-term payment plan, you will not be charged a user fee.
translation: जब तक आप अल्पकालिक भुगतान योजना के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त नहीं करते, आपसे उपयोगकर्ता शुल्क नहीं लिया जाएगा।
back: You will not be charged user fees unless you qualify for a short-term payment plan.

en: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived if you agree to make electronic debit payments.
bad_en: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived unless you agree to make electronic debit payments.
translation: यदि आप कम आय वाले करदाता हैं, तो इलेक्ट्रॉनिक डेबिट भुगतान करने के लिए सहमत होने पर उपयोगकर्ता शुल्क माफ कर दिया जाता है।
back: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived if you agree to make electronic debit payments.

en: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived if you agree to make electronic debit payments.
bad_en: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived unless you agree to make electronic debit payments.
translation: यदि आप कम आय वाले करदाता हैं, तो उपयोगकर्ता शुल्क माफ कर दिया जाता है जब तक कि आप इलेक्ट्रॉनिक डेबिट भुगतान करने के लिए सहमत नहीं होते।
back: If you are a low-income taxpayer, the user fee is waived as long as you agree to make electronic debit payments.

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
bad_en: Unless the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
translation: यदि विक्रेता ने आपको कोई वस्तु दी है, तो आपको उन्हें विक्रेता को उसी अच्छी स्थिति में उपलब्ध कराना होगा जैसे आपने उन्हें प्राप्त किया था।
back: If the Seller has given you any items, you must provide them to the Seller in the same good condition as you received them.

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
bad_en: Unless the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller in as good condition as when you got them.
translation: जब तक विक्रेता ने आपको कोई वस्तु नहीं दी है, आपको उन्हें विक्रेता को उसी अच्छी स्थिति में उपलब्ध कराना होगा जैसे आपने उन्हें प्राप्त किया था।
back: Unless the Seller has delivered the items to you, you must provide them to the Seller in the same good condition as you received them.

en: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is only extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination and a state agency enforcing that law.
bad_en: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is only extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination or a state agency enforcing that law.
translation: आयु भेदभाव के लिए, दाखिल करने की समय सीमा केवल 300 दिनों तक बढ़ाई जाती है यदि आयु भेदभाव को प्रतिबंधित करने वाला कोई राज्य कानून हो और उस कानून को लागू करने वाली कोई राज्य एजेंसी हो।
back: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is extended only by 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination and a state agency enforcing that law.

en: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is only extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination and a state agency enforcing that law.
bad_en: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is only extended to 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination or a state agency enforcing that law.
translation: आयु भेदभाव के लिए, दाखिल करने की समय सीमा केवल 300 दिनों तक बढ़ाई जाती है यदि आयु भेदभाव को प्रतिबंधित करने वाला कोई राज्य कानून है या उस कानून को लागू करने वाली कोई राज्य एजेंसी है।
back: For age discrimination, the filing deadline is extended only by 300 days if there is a state law prohibiting age discrimination or a state agency enforcing that law.

en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, and filed all required returns.
bad_en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, or filed all required returns.
translation: यदि आप पर कर, जुर्माना और ब्याज का संयुक्त रूप से $50,000 या उससे कम बकाया है और आपने सभी आवश्यक रिटर्न दाखिल किए हैं, तो आप ऑनलाइन आवेदन करने के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
back: If you owe a combined $50,000 or less in taxes, penalties and interest and have filed all required returns, you may qualify to apply online.

en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, and filed all required returns.
bad_en: You may qualify to apply online if you owe $50,000 or less in combined tax, penalties and interest, or filed all required returns.
translation: यदि आप पर संयुक्त कर, जुर्माना और ब्याज का $50,000 या उससे कम बकाया है, या आपने सभी आवश्यक रिटर्न दाखिल किए हैं, तो आप ऑनलाइन आवेदन करने के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
back: If you owe $50,000 or less in combined taxes, penalties and interest, or you have filed all required returns, you may qualify to apply online.

en: If you knowingly fail to report important changes, we may impose a sanction against your payments.
bad_en: Unless you knowingly fail to report important changes, we may impose a sanction against your payments.
translation: यदि आप जानबूझकर महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तनों की रिपोर्ट करने में विफल रहते हैं, तो हम आपके भुगतानों पर प्रतिबंध लगा सकते हैं।
back: If you deliberately fail to report material changes, we may restrict your payments.

en: If you knowingly fail to report important changes, we may impose a sanction against your payments.
bad_en: Unless you knowingly fail to report important changes, we may impose a sanction against your payments.
translation: जब तक आप जानबूझकर महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तनों की रिपोर्ट करने में विफल नहीं होते, हम आपके भुगतानों पर प्रतिबंध लगा सकते हैं।
back: Unless you knowingly fail to report material changes, we may place restrictions on your payments.

en: If you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
bad_en: Unless you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
translation: यदि आप ऋण संग्राहक को इस 30-दिन की अवधि के भीतर एक लिखित सत्यापन अनुरोध भेजते हैं, तो ऋण संग्राहक को उस राशि का संग्रह करना बंद कर देना चाहिए जिस पर आप विवाद कर रहे हैं।
back: If you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must stop collecting the amount you are disputing.

en: If you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
bad_en: Unless you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must pause collecting the amount you are disputing.
translation: जब तक आप ऋण संग्राहक को इस 30-दिन की अवधि के भीतर एक लिखित सत्यापन अनुरोध नहीं भेजते, ऋण संग्राहक को आपके द्वारा विवादित राशि एकत्र करना बंद कर देना चाहिए।
back: Unless you send the debt collector a written verification request within this 30-day period, the debt collector must stop collecting the amount you are disputing.

en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, unless your card expires before your 16th birthday.
bad_en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, if your card expires before your 16th birthday.
translation: यदि आपको अपना कार्ड 14 वर्ष की आयु से पहले प्राप्त हुआ था, तो आपको 14 वर्ष की आयु होने पर इसे बदलना होगा, जब तक कि आपका कार्ड आपके 16वें जन्मदिन से पहले समाप्त न हो जाए।
back: If you received your card before you turned 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, unless your card expires before your 16th birthday.

en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, unless your card expires before your 16th birthday.
bad_en: If you received your card before you were 14, you must replace it when you turn 14, if your card expires before your 16th birthday.
translation: यदि आपको अपना कार्ड 14 वर्ष की आयु से पहले प्राप्त हुआ था, तो आपको 14 वर्ष की आयु होने पर इसे बदलना होगा, यदि आपका कार्ड आपके 16वें जन्मदिन से पहले समाप्त हो जाता है।
back: If you received your card before you turned 14, you will need to replace it when you turn 14 if your card expires before your 16th birthday.

en: If we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.
bad_en: Unless we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.
translation: यदि हम आपका आवेदन स्वीकार कर लेते हैं, तो हम आपको एक नया ग्रीन कार्ड भेज देंगे।
back: If we approve your application, we will send you a new green card.

en: If we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.
bad_en: Unless we approve your application, we will mail you a new Green Card.
translation: जब तक हम आपका आवेदन स्वीकार नहीं कर लेते, हम आपको एक नया ग्रीन कार्ड भेज देंगे।
back: Unless we approve your application, we will send you a new green card.

en: If you don't make the items available to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as you agreed under the contract.
bad_en: Even if you make the items available to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as you agreed under the contract.
translation: यदि आप विक्रेता को आइटम उपलब्ध नहीं कराते हैं, तो आप अनुबंध के तहत सहमति के अनुसार विक्रेता को भुगतान करने के लिए जिम्मेदार रहेंगे।
back: If you do not provide the item to the seller, you will remain responsible to pay the seller as agreed under the contract.

en: If you don't make the items available to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as you agreed under the contract.
bad_en: Even if you make the items available to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as you agreed under the contract.
translation: भले ही आप विक्रेता को आइटम उपलब्ध कराते हैं, फिर भी आप अनुबंध के तहत सहमति के अनुसार विक्रेता को भुगतान करने के लिए जिम्मेदार रहते हैं।
back: Even though you provide the items to the seller, you remain responsible for paying the seller as agreed under the contract.

en: The seller must give you two copies of a cancellation form.
bad_en: You must give the seller two copies of a cancellation form.
translation: विक्रेता को आपको रद्दीकरण फॉर्म की दो प्रतियां देनी होंगी।
back: The seller must give you two copies of the cancellation form.

en: The seller must give you two copies of a cancellation form.
bad_en: You must give the seller two copies of a cancellation form.
translation: आपको विक्रेता को रद्दीकरण फॉर्म की दो प्रतियां देनी होंगी।
back: You must give two copies of the cancellation form to the seller.

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller.
bad_en: If you gave the seller any items, the seller must make them available to you.
translation: यदि विक्रेता ने आपको कोई वस्तु दी है, तो आपको उसे विक्रेता को उपलब्ध कराना होगा।
back: If the seller has given you an item, you must provide it to the seller.

en: If the seller gave you any items, you must make them available to the seller.
bad_en: If you gave the seller any items, the seller must make them available to you.
translation: यदि आपने विक्रेता को कोई वस्तु दी है, तो विक्रेता को उन्हें आपको उपलब्ध कराना होगा।
back: If you have given any items to the seller, the seller must provide them to you.

en: If we determine you must submit biometrics, we will mail you a biometrics appointment notice.
bad_en: If we determine you must submit biometrics, you must mail us a biometrics appointment request.
translation: यदि हम निर्धारित करते हैं कि आपको बायोमेट्रिक्स जमा करना होगा, तो हम आपको बायोमेट्रिक्स नियुक्ति नोटिस भेजेंगे।
back: If we determine that you must submit biometrics, we will send you a biometrics appointment notice.

en: If we determine you must submit biometrics, we will mail you a biometrics appointment notice.
bad_en: If we determine you must submit biometrics, you must mail us a biometrics appointment request.
translation: यदि हम निर्धारित करते हैं कि आपको बायोमेट्रिक्स जमा करना होगा, तो आपको हमें बायोमेट्रिक्स नियुक्ति अनुरोध मेल करना होगा।
back: If we determine that you must submit biometrics, you must mail us a Biometrics Appointment Request.

en: You must report any of these changes to us, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.
bad_en: We must report any of these changes to you, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.
translation: आपको इनमें से किसी भी बदलाव की सूचना हमें अवश्य देनी चाहिए, क्योंकि वे एसएसआई के लिए आपकी पात्रता को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं।
back: You must notify us of any of these changes, as they may affect your eligibility for SSI.

en: You must report any of these changes to us, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.
bad_en: We must report any of these changes to you, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.
translation: हमें इनमें से किसी भी परिवर्तन की सूचना आपको अवश्य देनी चाहिए, क्योंकि वे एसएसआई के लिए आपकी पात्रता को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं।
back: We must notify you of any of these changes, because they may affect your eligibility for SSI.

en: We may overpay you, and you may have to pay us back.
bad_en: You may overpay us, and we may have to pay you back.
translation: हम आपको अधिक भुगतान कर सकते हैं, और आपको हमें वापस भुगतान करना पड़ सकता है।
back: We may pay you more, and you may have to pay us back.

en: We may overpay you, and you may have to pay us back.

translation: आप हमें अधिक भुगतान कर सकते हैं और हमें आपको वापस भुगतान करना पड़ सकता है।
back: You may overpay us and we may have to pay you back.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once the debt collector receives your information, they have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: एक बार जब आप ऋण सत्यापन जानकारी प्राप्त कर लेते हैं, तो आपके पास ऋण पर लिखित रूप से विवाद करने के लिए 30 दिन का समय होता है।
back: Once you receive the loan verification information, you have 30 days to dispute the loan in writing.

en: Once you receive the debt validation information, you have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
bad_en: Once the debt collector receives your information, they have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.
translation: एक बार जब ऋण संग्राहक को आपकी जानकारी प्राप्त हो जाती है, तो उनके पास ऋण पर लिखित रूप से विवाद करने के लिए 30 दिन का समय होता है।
back: Once the debt collector receives your information, they have 30 days to dispute the debt in writing.

en: The debt collector must give you the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.
bad_en: You must give the debt collector the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.
translation: ऋण संग्राहक को आपको उस ऋणदाता का नाम अवश्य बताना चाहिए जिसका आप पर ऋण बकाया है।
back: The debt collector must tell you the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.

en: The debt collector must give you the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.
bad_en: You must give the debt collector the name of the creditor you owe the debt to.
translation: आपको ऋण संग्राहक को उस लेनदार का नाम देना होगा जिसका आप पर कर्ज़ बकाया है।
back: You must provide the debt collector with the name of the creditor you owe.

en: If the IRS approves your payment plan, a setup fee will be charged to you.
bad_en: If the IRS approves your payment plan, a setup fee will be paid to you.

bad_en: Severe liver damage may occur if you have five or more alcoholic drinks per day while using acetaminophen.

translation: ذیابیطس والے کچھ لوگ جو انسولین لیتے ہیں انہیں اپنے خون میں گلوکوز کے اہداف تک پہنچنے کے لیے دن میں 2 سے 4 گولیاں کھانے کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے۔
